normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We are still weighing up the alternatives.
options: A. 我們仍在權衡各種選擇。
B. 我們已排除所有替代方案。
C. 我們只是在測量物品重量。
D. 我們已決定不再考慮這件事。
normal.explain: weigh up the alternatives 表示比較選項利弊，still 表示尚未結束。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The figures are subject to revision.
options: A. 這些數字只供學生複習。
B. 這些數字之後可能修正。
C. 這些數字絕對不能修改。
D. 這些數字已證明完全錯誤。
normal.explain: subject to revision 表示仍可能修訂，並非已確定錯誤。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather we kept this between ourselves.
options: A. 我已經把這件事公開。
B. 我不想再和你討論任何事。
C. 我比較希望這件事只留在我們之間。
D. 我希望你把消息傳給每個人。
normal.explain: keep this between ourselves 是保密的委婉要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We need to take the maintenance costs into account.
options: A. 我們已經付清所有維護費。
B. 我們必須把維護費用納入考量。
C. 我們必須把維護費存進銀行。
D. 我們決定忽略維護費用。
normal.explain: take into account 是納入考量，不是付款或存款。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not opposed to the idea; I just doubt whether we can afford it.
options: A. 說話者保證經費完全沒有問題。
B. 說話者已經批准所有支出。
C. 說話者不反對構想，但質疑預算是否足夠。
D. 說話者認為構想本身毫無價值。
normal.explain: not opposed 與 doubt whether we can afford it 分別交代態度及財務顧慮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You need not have printed the report. We already had a digital copy.
options: A. 你還沒印報告，而且必須立即印。
B. 數位版本已遺失，必須補印。
C. 印報告是唯一可行的方法。
D. 你其實不必印報告，但已經印了。
normal.explain: need not have done 表示事情已做，但原本不必要。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The consultant was supposed to have sent the revised estimate by now.
options: A. 說話者確認估價已經收到。
B. 修正估價預定明年才開始製作。
C. 顧問照理現在應已寄出修正估價。
D. 顧問被禁止寄出修正估價。
normal.explain: was supposed to have sent 表達截至現在應完成的期待，並未確認收到。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not rule it out, but I would not count on it either.
options: A. 這件事已經確定會發生。
B. 這件事完全不可能發生。
C. 說話者要求立刻停止計數。
D. 這件事有可能，但不值得當成可靠指望。
normal.explain: not rule out 是不排除，not count on 是不要寄望；兩者共同保留不確定性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The cheaper option would save us money initially, though repairs could wipe out those savings.
options: A. 初期省下的錢可能被後續維修費抵銷。
B. 便宜方案保證終身沒有維修費。
C. 較貴方案已被證明不需要維修。
D. 說話者只比較兩個方案的顏色。
normal.explain: initially 限定初期，wipe out those savings 表示抵銷節省金額。

normal.desc: 【推測】The laboratory was locked all night, but the window was open this morning. Someone ___ left it open before locking up.
options: A. must have
B. must
C. has to
D. is to
normal.explain: must have＋過去分詞表示根據線索推測過去；其餘結構無法接 left 表達這個意思。

normal.desc: 【被動】The bridge is thought ___ during the storm last week.
options: A. to damaging
B. to have been damaged
C. to have damaged
D. having damaged
normal.explain: is thought to have been damaged 表示「被認為先前已受損」；橋是受損者，需完成式被動。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The company agreed to ___ responsibility for the error rather than blame the supplier.
options: A. resume
B. presume
C. assume
D. consume
normal.explain: assume responsibility 是承擔責任；consume 消耗、resume 恢復、presume 推定均不符合。

normal.desc: 【時態】The trial is still under way. Researchers ___ the new coating for six months now.
options: A. were to test
B. have been testing
C. had tested
D. will have tested
normal.explain: still under way 與 for six months now 表示從過去持續至今的測試，用現在完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【短文】The hotel advertises free parking. However, its underground garage is reserved for guests who book directly; other guests must use a paid public car park. What is the limitation?
options: A. Only guests without cars can book directly.
B. The public car park is free for every guest.
C. Free parking depends on how the booking is made.
D. All hotel guests must pay for parking.
normal.explain: 限制是訂房管道；直接向飯店訂房才可用免費車庫。不是所有人都付費，也未說公共停車場免費。

normal.desc: 【句意】The manager stopped short of promising a refund. What did the manager avoid doing?
options: A. Explaining why the meeting ended early.
B. Rejecting every possibility of a refund.
C. Returning less money than had been promised.
D. Making a definite commitment to return the money.
normal.explain: stop short of doing 表示沒有做到某一步；未承諾退款不等於排除退款。

normal.desc: 【文法】The report refers to a single incident: you lent me your access card yesterday. I cannot find my own now. If you ___ me your card yesterday, I would be unable to enter today.
options: A. have not lent
B. would not lend
C. had not lent
D. did not lend
normal.explain: 過去事件造成現在結果，混合條件句用 If＋過去完成式、would＋原形。這裡假設昨天沒有借卡。

normal.desc: 【短文】A city extended library hours for a three-month trial. Evening visits increased, but staff overtime also rose. The council requested a cost review before deciding whether to continue. What can be concluded?
options: A. The council has already approved permanent evening hours.
B. The trial failed to attract any additional visitors.
C. Staff overtime proves that all evening visits were unnecessary.
D. The extension attracted users, but its financial viability remains under review.
normal.explain: 人次增加與成本上升都有證據，是否繼續仍待評估；其餘選項加入未獲支持的結論。

normal.desc: 【語意】The proposal is workable in principle, though several practical obstacles remain. Which summary is most accurate?
options: A. The basic idea could work, but implementation is not yet straightforward.
B. The proposal is fully ready to implement without changes.
C. The basic idea is impossible regardless of practical details.
D. The obstacles have already been removed.
normal.explain: in principle 肯定原則可行，though 保留實務障礙；不能推論已準備完成或完全不可能。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：應變措施
請唸出單字：可行性
請唸出：互利的
請唸出：應優先處理的事
請唸出：我們應重新考慮背後的假設
normal.ans: WE SHOULD RECONSIDER THE UNDERLYING ASSUMPTIONS
normal.speak: we should reconsider the underlying assumptions
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD RECONSIDER THE UNDERLYING ASSUMPTIONS

normal.desc: 請唸出：好處大於潛在缺點
normal.ans: THE BENEFITS OUTWEIGH THE POTENTIAL DRAWBACKS
normal.speak: the benefits outweigh the potential drawbacks
normal.vocabId: R6:THE BENEFITS OUTWEIGH THE POTENTIAL DRAWBACKS

normal.desc: 請拼出：須對決策負責的責任（A 開頭，14 個字母）
填空題：A C C O U N T _ B I L I T Y (須對決策負責的責任)
請拼出：可能發生而須預作準備的意外情況（C 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：計畫能否實行的可行性（F 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：F E A _ I B I _ I T Y (計畫能否實行的可行性)
請拼出：事件帶來的間接負面後果（R 開頭，12 個字母）
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Could you give me a rough idea of the cost before I commit?
options: A. 說話者要在已付款後才討論價格。
B. 說話者想先知道大約費用，再決定是否答應。
C. 說話者已接受任何費用，不需再估價。
D. 說話者要求精確到最後一分錢才聽說明。
normal.explain: rough idea 是大致概念，before I commit 表示承諾前先了解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am happy to cover your shift, as long as we can swap next week.
options: A. 說話者已決定下週永久離職。
B. 說話者只願幫忙遮蓋制服。
C. 只要下週能交換班次，說話者願意代班。
D. 說話者不願在任何條件下代班。
normal.explain: cover your shift 是代班；as long as 連接交換班次的條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The exhibition has been extended due to popular demand.
options: A. 因無人參觀，展覽提早關閉。
B. 展覽場地已確定增加一倍。
C. 所有觀眾都被要求延後入場。
D. 因廣受歡迎，展覽延長了展期。
normal.explain: extended 在展覽語境指延長展期，popular demand 是觀眾熱烈要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: There is no point in setting off now; the last ferry has already left.
options: A. 現在出發沒有明確的目的地。
B. 渡輪公司還沒決定今天是否開船。
C. 現在出發已沒有意義，因為末班渡輪已開走。
D. 現在出發才能趕上即將離港的末班渡輪。
normal.explain: no point in 是沒有意義；has already left 確認末班船已離開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I do not mind paying a deposit, but I would like to know under what circumstances it is refundable.
options: A. 說話者堅持不論任何情況都不得收訂金。
B. 說話者已確認訂金絕對不能退。
C. 說話者只想知道訂金要用哪種顏色的信封。
D. 說話者願付訂金，但想先了解哪些情況可以退。
normal.explain: do not mind paying 與 would like to know 分別表示接受付款及詢問退款條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The venue is a little out of the way, but the shuttle service should make up for that.
options: A. 場地稍偏遠，但接駁服務應能彌補不便。
B. 場地交通便利，因此接駁服務已停駛。
C. 接駁車會把場地移到市中心。
D. 說話者認為接駁服務一定會使交通更糟。
normal.explain: out of the way 是偏遠；make up for 是補償某項缺點。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We are trying to strike a balance between preserving the building and making it accessible.
options: A. 我們只打算拆除建物，不考慮其他因素。
B. 我們已決定禁止公眾進入以方便維修。
C. 我們認為保存建物和使用便利完全沒有關係。
D. 我們正試著兼顧建物保存與無障礙使用。
normal.explain: strike a balance 是在兩項需求間取得平衡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not say the performance was bad; it just did not live up to the expectations created by the reviews.
options: A. 演出不算差，但未達評論讓人產生的期待。
B. 評論已警告演出很差，而說話者完全同意。
C. 說話者認為演出比所有評論說的都更出色。
D. 說話者沒有看演出，只讀了評論。
normal.explain: not bad 與 did not live up to expectations 是有限肯定加期待落差，不能簡化為全盤否定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The organiser said we could bring guests, but stopped short of saying that their meals would be included.
options: A. 主辦方明確要求每位來賓付同一筆固定費用。
B. 主辦方允許帶人，卻未承諾餐費也包含在內。
C. 主辦方已保證所有來賓的餐費全免。
D. 主辦方禁止帶人，只供應個人餐點。
normal.explain: stopped short of saying 表示沒有進一步承諾，並非已確定收費或免費。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The gallery hopes to ___ a wider audience without changing its focus on local artists.
options: A. extend
B. reach
C. arrive
D. attend
normal.explain: reach an audience 是觸及觀眾；arrive 後通常接 at/in，attend 是出席，extend 是延長或擴展某物。

normal.desc: 【語意】The guide advised us to allow for delays at the border. What should we do?
options: A. Assume that the crossing will certainly be closed.
B. Arrive without making any travel arrangements.
C. Include possible delays in our travel plans.
D. Ask border staff to make the delay longer.
normal.explain: allow for 是考量某因素、預留餘裕；不是允許對方刻意延誤。

normal.desc: 【文法】The rooms ___ at the moment, so guests are using the west entrance.
options: A. have renovating
B. are renovated being
C. are been renovated
D. are being renovated
normal.explain: at the moment 強調正在進行的被動，形式為 are being renovated。

normal.desc: 【對話】A colleague asks for feedback, but you need time to review the draft. Which reply agrees to help without promising immediate feedback?
options: A. I cannot help at any point this week.
B. You should send it without anyone reviewing it.
C. I can look it over and get back to you tomorrow.
D. I have already approved every part of it.
normal.explain: look it over 並約定明天回覆，表示願意協助但不立刻提供意見；其他選項不保留這個意思。

normal.desc: 【短文】A rail pass covers regional trains but excludes services that require a reservation. Lina plans to use a fast train for which a seat must be booked. What should she check?
options: A. Whether every regional train requires a seat booking.
B. Whether her pass includes all trains without exception.
C. Whether passengers can reserve a seat after leaving the train.
D. Whether a separate ticket is needed for that service.
normal.explain: 須預約的車種被排除，Lina 的車次符合此限制，因此應查是否另購車票。

normal.desc: 【語氣】We can accommodate your request, provided it does not affect the other bookings. What is being offered?
options: A. Conditional agreement to meet the request.
B. An apology for an error that has already occurred.
C. A refusal to consider any change.
D. Confirmation that all other bookings have been cancelled.
normal.explain: provided 提出條件；accommodate a request 是配合要求，非已取消其他訂單。

normal.desc: 【短文】The workshop is advertised as suitable for beginners, but participants must bring a laptop with the software installed. What does being a beginner not remove?
options: A. The right to ask questions during the workshop.
B. The possibility of learning a new skill.
C. The requirement to have completed an advanced course.
D. The need to prepare the required equipment.
normal.explain: 初學者也要自備已安裝軟體的筆電；沒有要求先完成進階課。

normal.desc: 【短文】A theatre offers discounted seats just before a performance. Tickets cannot be reserved, and availability depends on unsold seats. Nia needs six adjacent seats for a family celebration. Why is the offer risky for her?
options: A. It does not guarantee the seating arrangement her group needs.
B. The discount is available only to people attending alone.
C. The theatre has announced that no seats remain.
D. The tickets become more expensive when a performance begins.
normal.explain: 不能預訂且視剩餘座位決定，無法保證六個連座；其餘限制未被提及。

normal.desc: 【推論】The manager said the new schedule was intended to give staff more flexibility, not to reduce the total hours worked. Which change would conflict with that stated intention?
options: A. Keeping the total hours while offering different start times.
B. Using the schedule to cut the contracted weekly hours.
C. Letting staff start earlier and finish earlier.
D. Allowing the same hours to be spread differently.
normal.explain: 明說不是減少總工時，因此減少約定週工時與此意圖衝突；其他選項可以符合彈性排班。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：可供不同需求者便利使用的程度
請唸出單字：相互給予或回應的互惠原則
請唸出：視供應或空位情況而定
請唸出：雙方都能接受的安排
請唸出：在合理範圍內我們可以配合你的要求
normal.ans: WE CAN ACCOMMODATE YOUR REQUEST WITHIN REASON
normal.speak: we can accommodate your request within reason
normal.vocabId: R6:WE CAN ACCOMMODATE YOUR REQUEST WITHIN REASON

normal.desc: 請唸出：修訂後的時程已預留意外延誤的餘裕
normal.ans: THE REVISED SCHEDULE ALLOWS FOR UNEXPECTED DELAYS
normal.speak: the revised schedule allows for unexpected delays
normal.vocabId: R6:THE REVISED SCHEDULE ALLOWS FOR UNEXPECTED DELAYS

normal.desc: 請拼出：場所或服務可便利使用的程度（A 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：A C C E S S _ B I L I T Y (場所或服務可便利使用的程度)
請拼出：相互給予或回應的互惠原則（R 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：配合或滿足某人的需要（A 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：A C C _ M M O _ A T E (配合或滿足某人的需要)
請拼出：建築或設備的翻新整修（R 開頭，13 個字母）
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 強制性，必須遵守的程度
B. 可攜性，能隨身帶走的程度
C. 相容性，能一起正常運作的程度
D. 競爭力，能勝過對手的程度
normal.explain: compatibility 指軟硬體等能否配合運作，不是 competitiveness、compulsion 或 portability。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 某種產品供不應求的情況
B. 一項政策持續不變的時間
C. 一份資料公開發表的日期
D. 兩份資料或說法之間的出入
normal.explain: discrepancy 是原本應相符的事物之間的差異或不一致。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 取決於某項條件
B. 完全不受條件影響
C. 發生在另一件事之前
D. 與某項條件毫不相關
normal.explain: contingent on 表依某條件而定；不是時間先後或無條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would prefer to keep a local copy as a precaution.
options: A. 我已決定刪除所有本機和遠端副本。
B. 我只想把檔案寄給當地報紙。
C. 我認為預防措施沒有任何必要。
D. 我比較希望保留本機副本以防萬一。
normal.explain: local copy 在數位語境是本機副本；as a precaution 是預防性措施。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The service claims to be free, but some essential features are only available through a paid subscription.
options: A. 服務標榜免費，但部分必要功能須付費訂閱才能用。
B. 所有功能都可以免費使用，沒有任何限制。
C. 只要下載 app 就已付清終身訂閱費。
D. 服務只接受紙本申請，不提供數位功能。
normal.explain: claims to be free 與 paid subscription 呈現免費宣傳的限制。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not suggesting the review is dishonest; I just want to know whether the writer received the product for free.
options: A. 我只是在詢問讀者是否能免費閱讀評論。
B. 我沒有斷言評論不誠實，只想了解作者是否免費取得產品。
C. 我已證明作者收錢寫假評論。
D. 我認為免費取得產品必然讓評論虛假。
normal.explain: not suggesting 限制指控強度；詢問取得產品方式是了解可能的利益關係。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: By the time we realised the settings had changed, several files had already been shared publicly.
options: A. 發現設定改變時，已有幾個檔案公開分享。
B. 設定在所有檔案刪除後才改變。
C. 我們在任何檔案公開前就已發現並阻止。
D. 所有檔案都確定從未對外分享。
normal.explain: 兩個過去完成式交代發現前已發生的設定變化和公開分享。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: An improvement in average performance does not necessarily mean that every user will notice a difference.
options: A. 只要有人沒察覺差異，平均數就一定是錯的。
B. 平均表現提升不代表每位使用者都會察覺差異。
C. 每位使用者的表現都已被證明完全相同。
D. 平均表現提升必定代表任何人都受益。
normal.explain: not necessarily 阻止從平均推到每一個個體的過度概括。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would be more comfortable recommending it if the company were clearer about how long the data is retained.
options: A. 我只關心裝置的外觀，資料政策不重要。
B. 公司已承諾完全不收集任何資料。
C. 若公司更清楚說明資料保留多久，我會更願意推薦。
D. 公司已清楚說明保留時間，所以我無條件推薦。
normal.explain: 假設語氣表達推薦的保留條件；沒有斷言公司不收集資料。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The two devices are fully ___, so the same charger can be used for both.
options: A. compulsory
B. comparable
C. compatible
D. competitive
normal.explain: compatible 指能相容使用；competitive 有競爭力、compulsory 強制、comparable 可比較均不表相容性。

normal.desc: 【文法】The password should ___ before anyone outside the team is given access.
options: A. have changing
B. be changing by
C. change it
D. be changed
normal.explain: password 是被更改的對象，should 後接 be＋過去分詞。

normal.desc: 【句意】The update is optional rather than mandatory. Which statement is accurate?
options: A. Users may choose whether to install it.
B. Users are required to install it immediately.
C. Users are forbidden to install it.
D. Users must uninstall the existing version.
normal.explain: optional 是可選擇的，mandatory 是強制的；沒有安裝或移除的絕對要求。

normal.desc: 【條件】The backup runs automatically unless the computer is switched off. When would the stated exception apply?
options: A. When the user opens another document.
B. Whenever the user forgets to start the backup manually.
C. Whenever the computer has an internet connection.
D. When the computer is not powered on.
normal.explain: unless 引入例外；電腦關機才符合所述例外，不代表其他狀況的備份一定成功。

normal.desc: 【短文】A fitness app offers a free trial, then charges a monthly fee unless users cancel. Removing the app from a phone does not cancel the subscription. What should a user do to avoid the fee?
options: A. Cancel the subscription through the required process before billing begins.
B. Remove the app and assume that this ends the subscription.
C. Stop opening the app after the trial ends.
D. Wait for the first bill before deciding whether the trial was free.
normal.explain: 文中明說移除 app 不等於取消訂閱；避免計費須在開始扣款前依流程取消。

normal.desc: 【語意】The system is reliable on the whole, though occasional interruptions are inevitable. Which summary preserves the qualification?
options: A. Its reliability depends entirely on the colour of the device.
B. It generally works well but cannot be expected to operate without any interruption.
C. Its interruptions happen so often that it never works.
D. It works perfectly whenever anyone uses it.
normal.explain: on the whole 是整體而言，occasional interruptions 保留偶發中斷。

normal.desc: 【短文】A navigation app marks a route as fastest based on normal traffic. It has not received live updates since the morning. Which factor could make the recommendation less useful now?
options: A. Traffic conditions may have changed since the data was last updated.
B. The route is necessarily longer than every alternative.
C. The app has promised that no road can ever close.
D. Normal traffic data cannot contain any information about routes.
normal.explain: 缺乏即時更新表示可能未反映當前路況；不是已證明路線最長或完全沒有資訊。

normal.desc: 【短文】A shop reports that a new checkout page increased sales. The same week, it also cut prices and ran a major advertising campaign. What prevents a firm conclusion about the page alone?
options: A. Advertising proves that the sales figures were invented.
B. Other changes could also have influenced the sales increase.
C. A checkout page cannot influence sales under any circumstances.
D. A price cut always reduces the number of purchases.
normal.explain: 同時改變價格與廣告，無法將銷售增長單獨歸因於頁面；其他選項都是過強或無根據的說法。

normal.desc: 【語氣】A reviewer says: The device is not so much difficult to use as difficult to justify at that price. What is the main reservation?
options: A. Its complete inability to perform its advertised functions.
B. Its ease of use as the only reason to buy it.
C. Its value for money rather than its usability.
D. Its screen brightness rather than its battery life.
normal.explain: not so much A as B 把主要疑慮放在價格是否值得，而非操作難度。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：彼此依賴而互相影響的
請唸出單字：能追查來源與歷程的特性
請唸出：在缺乏證據的情況下
請唸出：可能的利益衝突
請唸出：標題誇大了證據的強度
normal.ans: THE HEADLINE OVERSTATES THE STRENGTH OF THE EVIDENCE
normal.speak: the headline overstates the strength of the evidence
normal.vocabId: R6:THE HEADLINE OVERSTATES THE STRENGTH OF THE EVIDENCE

normal.desc: 請唸出：分享之前我們應先核實說法
normal.ans: WE SHOULD VERIFY THE CLAIM BEFORE SHARING IT
normal.speak: we should verify the claim before sharing it
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD VERIFY THE CLAIM BEFORE SHARING IT

normal.desc: 請拼出：系統或資訊值得信賴的可靠程度（R 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：決策或程序可被清楚了解的透明程度（T 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：在了解情況下給予的同意（C 開頭，7 個字母）
填空題：D I S C L _ S U R E (將原本未公開資訊揭露的行為)
填空題：R E T _ N T _ O N (將資料或物品持續保留)
填空題：A U T _ E N _ I C _ T Y (事物為真而非偽造的特性)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 維持原狀而永不變動的要求
B. 達成目標前投入的總金額
C. 為宣傳活動設計的形象
D. 面對衝擊後恢復或調整的能力
normal.explain: resilience 指承受衝擊與恢復適應的能力，不等於完全不改變。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把可用資源分配到不同用途
B. 把使用過的資源全部丟棄
C. 將所有資源保留而禁止使用
D. 估算資源最初被發現的年份
normal.explain: allocation 是分配，這裡指資源如何安排用途。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在計畫正式開始以前
B. 從長期結果來看
C. 在下一次跑步比賽期間
D. 僅限最初實施的幾天
normal.explain: in the long run 是長遠而言，不是跑步活動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The disruption should be temporary, provided the work stays on schedule.
options: A. 只要工程如期，影響應是暫時的。
B. 工程是否如期都保證完全不影響生活。
C. 工程已確定無限期延誤。
D. 所有工程必須等影響消失後才開始。
normal.explain: provided 設定條件，should 是合理預期而非無條件保證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The figures include the energy used in production, not just the electricity consumed while the device is running.
options: A. 裝置停止運轉時仍會自動生產電力。
B. 數字納入製造耗能，不只計算運作時用電。
C. 數字只計算插電後的耗能。
D. 製造過程已被證明完全不耗能。
normal.explain: not just 擴大計算邊界，production 和 running 是不同階段。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I support improving the road, but I am not convinced widening it is the only way to do that.
options: A. 我確定拓寬是唯一可行辦法。
B. 我認為拓寬道路永遠不可能有幫助。
C. 我支持改善道路，但不認為拓寬已被證明是唯一辦法。
D. 我反對任何形式的道路改善。
normal.explain: 支持目的不等於接受某手段是唯一選項；也未否定其可能效用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have reduced the amount of packaging, but the material itself is still difficult to recycle.
options: A. 減少用量已自動解決所有回收問題。
B. 包材用量減少了，但材質仍難回收。
C. 材質變得易回收，但用量完全沒變。
D. 包材已全部取消，不再使用任何材料。
normal.explain: 用量和材質可回收性是兩個不同面向。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like a saving on the construction budget may turn into higher maintenance costs over the building’s lifetime.
options: A. 維護費已被包含在所有工程報價中。
B. 建築使用壽命與成本評估完全無關。
C. 建造時看似省錢，卻可能帶來較高的長期維護費。
D. 初期省錢保證終身維護費也較低。
normal.explain: may 表可能性，重點是短期預算與全生命週期成本不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The proposal would benefit frequent travellers more than occasional users, which is worth considering before calling it fair to everyone.
options: A. 所有使用者獲益已被證明完全相同。
B. 偶爾使用者是唯一能得到好處的人。
C. 說話者已要求禁止常客使用服務。
D. 方案對常客較有利，宣稱人人公平前應考量差異。
normal.explain: 比較受益分配，不等於否定所有好處或要求禁用。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The council introduced measures to ___ the impact of construction noise on residents.
options: A. migrate
B. imitate
C. cultivate
D. mitigate
normal.explain: mitigate 是減輕負面影響；其餘分別為遷移、模仿與培育。

normal.desc: 【文法】The old warehouse ___ into a community centre when funding was withdrawn.
options: A. was being converted
B. has converting
C. was converting it
D. had being converted
normal.explain: 資金撤回時整修正進行，且倉庫是被改建的對象，用過去進行式被動。

normal.desc: 【句意】The scheme is intended to supplement, rather than replace, the existing bus service. What is planned?
options: A. Postponing every change until the bus service ends.
B. Adding support while keeping the existing service.
C. Removing buses and using the new scheme instead.
D. Maintaining the existing service without any addition.
normal.explain: supplement 是補充，不是取代；原服務仍保留。

normal.desc: 【條件】Residents can borrow the equipment on condition that it is returned by Friday. Which requirement is explicit?
options: A. The equipment must be brought back by Friday.
B. Borrowers must purchase it after using it.
C. It may be kept indefinitely if unused.
D. Only residents with cars may borrow it.
normal.explain: on condition that 指借用的明確條件是週五前歸還。

normal.desc: 【短文】A city offers free bike hire for journeys under thirty minutes. Longer journeys incur a fee, even when the bike is returned to the original station. What determines whether a fee applies?
options: A. Whether the rider uses the same bicycle twice.
B. The duration of the journey.
C. Whether the bicycle returns to the same station.
D. The number of stations passed along the route.
normal.explain: 題目只以騎乘時間區分收費，回原站也不能免除超時費。

normal.desc: 【語意】The new park is a welcome addition, albeit smaller than originally proposed. Which summary is accurate?
options: A. The park is larger than every earlier proposal.
B. The original proposal contained no park at all.
C. The park is appreciated despite a reduction in its planned size.
D. The park has been rejected because of its size.
normal.explain: welcome addition 表肯定，albeit 保留面積比原計畫小。

normal.desc: 【短文】The recycling guide accepts clean paper containers but excludes those with a plastic lining. A takeaway cup is mostly paper but has such a lining. Which instruction follows the guide?
options: A. Put the cup in the collection only when it is full.
B. Do not place the cup in that paper collection.
C. Treat every mostly paper item as acceptable.
D. Remove every printed label before any recycling.
normal.explain: 有塑膠內襯即符合排除條件，不能只看紙張比例。此為虛構指南，不代表各地實際規則。

normal.desc: 【短文】A building uses less electricity per occupant after renovation. Its occupancy has also increased substantially. Why is this insufficient to establish a fall in total electricity use?
options: A. The building must now be using exactly the same total amount.
B. Occupancy and electricity use are defined as the same measurement.
C. A larger number of occupants could offset the reduction per person.
D. Renovation cannot affect electricity use.
normal.explain: 每人用量降低與人數增加須合併計算，總量可能升降，不能直接定論。

normal.desc: 【立場】The pedestrian scheme has improved the square, but its success should not obscure the difficulties faced by deliveries. What does the writer support?
options: A. Reversing the scheme because it has produced no benefits.
B. Ignoring deliveries because the square looks better.
C. Claiming that all users have benefited equally.
D. Recognising the improvement while addressing a remaining practical problem.
normal.explain: 先肯定改善，再要求處理送貨困難；非全盤取消或忽視問題。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：生物種類與生態差異的多樣性
請唸出單字：事物能持續存在或運作的可行程度
請唸出：與問題程度相稱的回應
請唸出：可以事先預見的後果
請唸出：好處必須與成本一起權衡
normal.ans: THE BENEFITS MUST BE WEIGHED AGAINST THE COSTS
normal.speak: the benefits must be weighed against the costs
normal.vocabId: R6:THE BENEFITS MUST BE WEIGHED AGAINST THE COSTS

normal.desc: 請唸出：居民應在過程中有發言權
normal.ans: RESIDENTS SHOULD HAVE A SAY IN THE PROCESS
normal.speak: residents should have a say in the process
normal.vocabId: R6:RESIDENTS SHOULD HAVE A SAY IN THE PROCESS

normal.desc: 請拼出：保護自然資源而避免浪費或破壞（C 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：資源因持續使用而減少耗盡（D 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：能自然補充而可再生的（R 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：E M I S _ I O N S (排放到空氣中的氣體或物質)
填空題：S C _ R C _ T Y (可用物品或資源不足的情況)
填空題：D I S _ L A _ E M _ N T (人或事物被迫離開原本位置)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 能熟練運用某項技能的程度
B. 參與一項活動的出席紀錄
C. 等待開始練習的時間
D. 授課者擁有的教室數量
normal.explain: proficiency 是熟練程度，不是出席證明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 單純比較學生家庭背景
B. 能幫助改善表現的具體回饋
C. 只給分數而不說明原因
D. 為避免不快而隱藏所有問題
normal.explain: constructive 強調有助改善，而非只稱讚或只批評。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只在教師催促後才開始
B. 在課程開始以前完成全部內容
C. 按適合自己的進度
D. 依所有人相同的速度
normal.explain: at your own pace 允許個別調整進度。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The example is meant to illustrate the rule, not cover every possible exception.
options: A. 教師要求學生不再參考例子。
B. 例子用來說明規則，不是涵蓋所有例外。
C. 例子已列出每一個可能例外。
D. 規則因有例外而完全不能使用。
normal.explain: illustrate 與 exhaustive coverage 是不同用途。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather you explained your reasoning than simply told me which answer you selected.
options: A. 我要求你先選錯再解釋。
B. 我希望你把所有人的答案背下來。
C. 我更希望你解釋推理，而不只報出選項。
D. 我只想知道選項，完全不需要原因。
normal.explain: would rather...than... 比較兩種回應；重點在理由。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The task became easier once I recognised the pattern, although applying it in a new context still took practice.
options: A. 看出模式已自動解決所有新情境。
B. 說話者認為規律完全無法幫助解題。
C. 新情境與原本學習毫無關聯。
D. 看出模式後題目較容易，但新情境運用仍須練習。
normal.explain: recognise 與 apply 分開；although 保留遷移需要練習。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I thought I had mastered the topic until I had to explain it without looking at my notes.
options: A. 我認為只要有筆記就不需要理解。
B. 老師已要求我永遠不得再看筆記。
C. 直到不看筆記解釋時，我才發現自己未如原想那麼熟練。
D. 我在第一次接觸主題前就已能完整解釋。
normal.explain: thought...until... 表後來經驗修正原先自評。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A correct answer obtained with a hint is useful practice, but it tells us less about independent recall than an answer produced unaided.
options: A. 提示下答對完全沒有任何學習價值。
B. 有提示和無提示都已證明相同的獨立能力。
C. 只要答案正確，就能確定沒有使用提示。
D. 提示下答對有練習價值，但較難證明獨立回想能力。
normal.explain: 保留練習價值，同時區分能力證據的強弱。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The progress is encouraging, though we need to see whether it persists after the intensive support has been withdrawn.
options: A. 進步值得鼓勵，但還要觀察密集支援撤除後能否維持。
B. 支援撤除後的表現已獲長期證實。
C. 進步不存在，只是教師計分出錯。
D. 說話者反對任何形式的學習支援。
normal.explain: persistence after withdrawal 是尚待觀察的條件，不是否定已見進步。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Students are encouraged to ___ on the feedback before submitting a revised draft.
options: A. reflect
B. reflecting
C. reflective
D. reflection
normal.explain: be encouraged to 後接動詞原形 reflect；reflect on 是仔細思考。

normal.desc: 【時態】She began learning the language last spring and is still taking lessons. She ___ it for almost a year.
options: A. was to study
B. has been studying
C. had been studied
D. will have studied
normal.explain: 從過去持續到現在的活動，用現在完成進行式；其他形式不表同一時間關係。

normal.desc: 【語意】The qualification is desirable but not essential. What does this mean for applicants?
options: A. Holding it guarantees that an applicant will be selected.
B. Applicants are advised to avoid mentioning it.
C. Having it is an advantage, but lacking it does not automatically rule someone out.
D. Anyone without it is automatically ineligible.
normal.explain: desirable 是有利，not essential 表非必要，不能推出保證錄取。

normal.desc: 【條件】You may retake the assessment, provided you complete the feedback session first. What must happen beforehand?
options: A. Withdrawal from the current course.
B. Participation in the feedback session.
C. Payment for a completely different qualification.
D. A guarantee of a higher score.
normal.explain: provided 表重測條件，first 明確要求先完成回饋課程。

normal.desc: 【短文】A writing workshop limits enrolment to twelve so that each participant can receive individual feedback. A second instructor would be needed before the group could grow. What currently limits expansion?
options: A. A lack of interest in writing among applicants.
B. A decision to remove individual feedback entirely.
C. The capacity to provide the intended level of feedback.
D. A rule prohibiting any additional instructor.
normal.explain: 人數限制與回饋人力相關；未說不准增聘或沒人想參加。

normal.desc: 【語氣】Your essay is clearer, though the conclusion could still be more closely linked to the evidence. What is the feedback?
options: A. The essay is less clear than the previous draft.
B. The conclusion should be removed regardless of its content.
C. No aspect of the essay has improved.
D. There has been progress, with a specific area still needing work.
normal.explain: 肯定 clearer，再指出結論與證據連結仍待加強。

normal.desc: 【短文】The certificate confirms attendance at all sessions. It does not report a test result or certify professional competence. What can it establish?
options: A. That the holder is qualified for every related job.
B. That the holder outperformed the other participants.
C. That the holder attended the required sessions.
D. That the holder passed a professional licensing exam.
normal.explain: 文件只證明出席，不能擴張為考試通過或專業能力認證。

normal.desc: 【短文】Learners scored higher when retaking the same quiz immediately after seeing the answers. The teacher wants to know whether they can use the material independently a week later. What would provide more relevant evidence?
options: A. Another immediate retake with the answer sheet open.
B. A count of how many times the answer sheet was viewed.
C. A record of how attractive learners found the quiz layout.
D. An unseen task after a delay, without access to the answers.
normal.explain: 新情境、延遲和無提示更直接檢驗獨立運用；即時照答案重答不能充分證明。

normal.desc: 【推論】The course was challenging without being discouraging. Which description best fits?
options: A. Learners had to work, but still felt able to make progress.
B. The material required no effort from anyone.
C. Learners were persuaded that improvement was impossible.
D. Every learner completed every task without making an error.
normal.explain: without being 區分有挑戰與使人氣餒；不等於完全無錯。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：能自主作決定的能力或權利
請唸出單字：經過學習或努力達到的成果
請唸出：能轉用到其他情境的技能
請唸出：理解上的缺口
請唸出：回饋應指出實際可行的下一步

normal.speak: feedback should identify a practical next step
normal.vocabId: R6:FEEDBACK SHOULD IDENTIFY A PRACTICAL NEXT STEP

normal.desc: 請唸出：我們需要獨立運用能力的證據
normal.ans: WE NEED EVIDENCE OF INDEPENDENT APPLICATION
normal.speak: we need evidence of independent application
normal.vocabId: R6:WE NEED EVIDENCE OF INDEPENDENT APPLICATION

normal.desc: 請拼出：能有效完成任務的能力（C 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：使已學知識或成果更加穩固（C 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：使某項活動更容易進行（F 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：R E I N F O _ C E M E N T (使行為或學習效果更穩固的強化)
填空題：C O M P _ E H E _ S I O N (理解語言或內容的能力)
填空題：P E R _ E V _ R A _ C E (遇到困難仍持續努力的毅力)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 演員在場上移動的速度
B. 各部分連成整體的連貫程度
C. 作品發行到市場的日期
D. 讀者對價格的接受程度
normal.explain: cohesion 指連結成整體的特性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 要求作者證明所有場景真實
B. 把結局延後到下一次演出
C. 暫時接受虛構設定而投入故事
D. 停止相信故事中的任何人物
normal.explain: suspend disbelief 是欣賞虛構作品時暫置現實質疑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只閱讀每一行的第一個字
B. 完全忽略作者的措辭
C. 依字母順序重新排列句子
D. 從未明說的地方理解隱意
normal.explain: read between the lines 是理解字面之外的暗示。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The performance is restrained rather than emotionless.
options: A. 演出因情緒過度激烈而失去控制。
B. 演員拒絕上場演出。
C. 演出有所節制，但並非沒有感情。
D. 演出完全沒有任何情緒。
normal.explain: restrained 是克制，rather than 排除 emotionless 的較強否定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I enjoyed the atmosphere, although I sometimes felt the style was doing more work than the story itself.
options: A. 我認為故事強到完全不需要任何風格。
B. 我完全無法察覺作品的氛圍。
C. 我只關心演員的工作時間。
D. 我喜歡氛圍，但有時覺得形式比故事本身更支撐作品。
normal.explain: style doing more work 比喻形式承擔主要效果，仍保留氛圍的肯定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The ending is unexpected, but it does make sense when you look back at the earlier clues.
options: A. 結局出人意料，但回看先前線索便說得通。
B. 結局完全沒有任何前文支持。
C. 所有讀者一開始就已知道結局。
D. 前面的線索直到結局後才被作者刪除。
normal.explain: unexpected 與 retrospectively coherent 可同時成立。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The reviewer took the line literally, whereas the context suggests it was meant as a joke.
options: A. 評論者和上下文都確定那是嚴肅承諾。
B. 說話者主張所有句子都只能當玩笑。
C. 評論者已承認自己沒有讀過那句話。
D. 評論者按字面解讀，但前後文顯示那句話原是玩笑。
normal.explain: literally 與 joke 的語用差異會改變評價。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The film leaves room for more than one interpretation, but not every interpretation is equally supported by what we see.
options: A. 電影容許多種解讀，但各種解讀不一定同樣有畫面根據。
B. 多重解讀就表示任何說法都同樣正確。
C. 只要有畫面，就不可能存在不同解讀。
D. 說話者認為觀眾只能重述劇情而不能解釋。
normal.explain: 多義性不等於沒有證據界線。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What disappointed me was not the lack of a happy ending, but the way the final decision contradicted everything we had learned about the character.
options: A. 我不知道故事最後是否有任何決定。
B. 我失望的不是沒有圓滿結局，而是最後決定違背此前的角色塑造。
C. 我只因結局不快樂就否定整部作品。
D. 我認為最後決定充分延續角色一貫行為。
normal.explain: not...but... 精確定位批評在人物一致性。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ending is deliberately ___: the reader is not told which of the two explanations is true.
options: A. annual
B. ambiguous
C. authentic
D. anonymous
normal.explain: ambiguous 表有多種可能解讀；其餘不表結局的不確定性。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which verb combines with tension to mean increasing it? The director wanted the silence to ___ tension.
options: A. relieve
B. release
C. build
D. ease
normal.explain: build tension 是增加緊張感；其餘選項指緩解或釋放，語意方向不同。

normal.desc: 【句意】The film is loosely based on the novel. What does loosely indicate?
options: A. The film has no connection with the novel.
B. Every scene reproduces the novel exactly.
C. The film was released before any version of the novel existed.
D. The film draws on the novel without following it closely in every detail.
normal.explain: loosely based on 指非逐細節忠實改編，不是否定所有關聯。

normal.desc: 【語氣】The reviewer calls the film engaging, if somewhat predictable. What is the assessment?
options: A. It fails to interest the reviewer at any point.
B. Its plot is praised as wholly original.
C. It holds attention despite a fairly easy-to-guess plot.
D. Its unpredictability makes it impossible to follow.
normal.explain: engaging 肯定吸引力，if 引入 predictable 的保留。

normal.desc: 【短文】In the first scene, a character insists she never keeps secrets. The next scene shows her hiding a letter before anyone enters. What does the contrast encourage the audience to question?
options: A. Whether the letter was written in the same language as the dialogue.
B. Whether anyone else has ever entered the room.
C. Whether the character knows how to read.
D. Whether her statement about herself can be trusted.
normal.explain: 自述和可見行動不一致，直接質疑可信度；其他資訊未提供。

normal.desc: 【語意】The novel leaves the reader to draw the connection. What does it avoid?
options: A. Stating the relationship explicitly.
B. Presenting any events that might be related.
C. Allowing readers to interpret the events.
D. Including characters who have different views.
normal.explain: leave...to draw the connection 是讓讀者自行建立關聯。

normal.desc: 【推論】The exhibition places an everyday object beside its expensive imitation. The labels ask what makes one seem more valuable. What is the likely purpose?
options: A. To prove that imitations are always less expensive.
B. To provide instructions for manufacturing the object.
C. To announce a fixed price for every exhibit.
D. To invite reflection on how value is assigned.
normal.explain: 標籤的問題引導思考價值判斷，沒有宣告普遍價格規則。

normal.desc: 【短文】The narrator says the town welcomed him warmly. Yet he describes closed doors, unanswered greetings and conversations that stop when he approaches. Which reading is best supported?
options: A. His positive account conflicts with the evidence he supplies.
B. The townspeople have explicitly explained their warm welcome.
C. Every described action proves that he has visited the town before.
D. The narration establishes that no one in the town can speak.
normal.explain: 正面總評與具體細節不一致，可質疑其解讀；不能任意補上動機或背景。

normal.desc: 【立場】A critic says the adaptation is faithful to the spirit of the book while departing from its sequence of events. What is preserved?
options: A. The title alone, with no other connection.
B. The underlying qualities rather than the exact order of the plot.
C. The precise chronology rather than the book’s tone.
D. Every line of dialogue and every scene.
normal.explain: faithful to spirit 與 departing from sequence 分別指內在特質與事件次序。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：能喚起鮮明感受或記憶的
請唸出單字：情節或說法合理可信的程度
請唸出：敘述未必可信的敘事者
請唸出：刻意營造的對比
請唸出：結局讓留意先前線索的人得到回報
normal.ans: THE ENDING REWARDS ATTENTION TO EARLIER CLUES
normal.speak: the ending rewards attention to earlier clues
normal.vocabId: R6:THE ENDING REWARDS ATTENTION TO EARLIER CLUES

normal.desc: 請唸出：即使設定不尋常氛圍仍令人信服
normal.ans: THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS CONVINCING DESPITE THE UNUSUAL SETTING
normal.speak: the atmosphere remains convincing despite the unusual setting
normal.vocabId: R6:THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS CONVINCING DESPITE THE UNUSUAL SETTING

normal.desc: 請拼出：文字或情境有多種解讀的特性（A 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：作品中喚起感官經驗的意象（I 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：事件依時間先後排列的順序（C 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：I R _ N Y (字面說法與實際意圖或情況的反差)
填空題：S A _ I _ E (透過幽默誇張批評社會現象的作品或手法)
填空題：A D _ P T _ T _ O N (將作品改為另一種形式的版本)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 改善被禁止的明確範圍
B. 評估工作已結束的時間
C. 仍有可以改善的空間
D. 改善成果已獲最終確認
normal.explain: scope for 指有進行某事的空間或機會。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只有主管在場時才可決定
B. 無論情況如何都不得改變
C. 必須按照固定日期抽籤
D. 由你依情況自行決定
normal.explain: at your discretion 是授予一定裁量，並非無限制權力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 具有優先地位
B. 與其他事項完全同時完成
C. 放棄既有承諾
D. 先向每個人道歉
normal.explain: take precedence 是優先，不是單純時間先後。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The suggestion is worth considering, even if we cannot implement it immediately.
options: A. 建議因無法立刻實施而毫無價值。
B. 建議已經完整實施並不需再討論。
C. 所有值得考慮的建議都必須當天實施。
D. 建議值得考慮，即使無法立刻實施。
normal.explain: 價值與立即實施能力是不同判斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather flag the problem now than let you discover it after the deadline.
options: A. 我寧願現在提醒問題，不願讓你在期限後才發現。
B. 我希望先隱藏問題以免影響期限。
C. 問題已在期限後由你先發現。
D. 我只有在你要求後才會討論問題。
normal.explain: flag a problem 是提出警示，rather...than... 表選擇提早說明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have agreed on the outcome, but not yet on who will be responsible for each step.
options: A. 只要目標一致，就代表責任歸屬也已清楚。
B. 目標成果已議定，但各步驟由誰負責還沒定。
C. 各步驟分工已定，但沒有任何共同目標。
D. 雙方已取消所有合作。
normal.explain: outcome 與 responsibilities 分開，不能把前者當成後者。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am happy to revisit the decision if new information comes to light.
options: A. 若出現新資訊，我願重新檢視決定。
B. 決定已經撤回，無需任何理由。
C. 任何新資訊都不會影響原決定。
D. 說話者只想重新拜訪會議地點。
normal.explain: revisit decision 是重新考慮，以新資訊為條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The wording leaves us some room to manoeuvre, although I would not interpret that as permission to disregard the underlying agreement.
options: A. 說話者確認每項原則都可任意放棄。
B. 措辭留有調整空間，但不代表可忽視原協議。
C. 調整空間已使原協議完全失效。
D. 措辭沒有任何可作判斷的餘裕。
normal.explain: room to manoeuvre 指有限彈性，後句限制其範圍。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A compromise is only useful if both sides understand what has been conceded and what has not.
options: A. 雙方必須放棄所有要求才算妥協。
B. 理解讓步內容表示所有分歧都已永久消失。
C. 妥協要有用，雙方需理解哪些已讓步、哪些尚未讓步。
D. 妥協只要名字好聽就不需明確條件。
normal.explain: 重點是清楚知道讓步範圍，不是要求全盤讓步。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The manager agreed to ___ some responsibility to the experienced team members.
options: A. deteriorate
B. deviate
C. delegate
D. deliberate
normal.explain: delegate responsibility 是委派責任；其他詞不表交付權責。

normal.desc: 【句意】The offer is open to negotiation. What does this imply?
options: A. The offer has already been withdrawn.
B. The recipient must accept every term unchanged.
C. The recipient has been guaranteed every requested change.
D. Some terms may be discussed rather than treated as final.
normal.explain: 可協商表示條件未必全固定，不保證對方會同意所有修改。

normal.desc: 【文法】The deadline cannot be changed without ___ the clients first.
options: A. consulting
B. consult
C. to consult
D. consulted
normal.explain: 介系詞 without 後接動名詞 consulting，表示未先諮詢就不能改期。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The team reached a ___ after discussing the competing proposals.
options: A. consumption
B. consequence
C. concessionary
D. consensus
normal.explain: reach a consensus 是達成共識，其他詞不合此搭配與意思。

normal.desc: 【短文】A supervisor asks for a report by Friday but says the figures must be verified first. The analyst expects verification to finish on Monday. What should the analyst raise?
options: A. The conflict between the requested deadline and the verification requirement.
B. A guarantee that unverified figures are already acceptable.
C. A claim that the report has no deadline.
D. A request to remove every numerical result permanently.
normal.explain: 兩項要求在預估時程上衝突，應澄清優先順序而非自行假設可省驗證。

normal.desc: 【語氣】I appreciate the effort, but this is not quite what we agreed. What is being communicated?
options: A. An unconditional acceptance of the result.
B. Recognition of the work alongside concern about whether it meets the agreement.
C. Confirmation that the work precisely matches the agreement.
D. A claim that no effort was made.
normal.explain: 前半肯定付出，but 指出成果與約定有落差。

normal.desc: 【短文】An employee is told she may arrange her own hours, provided someone remains available to answer customer calls throughout the day. What limits the flexibility?
options: A. The need to maintain coverage for customer calls.
B. A requirement that she work every hour of the day alone.
C. A ban on discussing schedules with colleagues.
D. A rule that every employee must arrive at the same time.
normal.explain: 條件是服務不中斷，未要求她單獨全日值班或全員同時上班。

normal.desc: 【短文】A company rewards teams for closing support requests quickly. Staff begin closing requests before customers confirm that the problem is solved. What has the incentive encouraged?
options: A. Measuring service quality independently of closure speed.
B. Improving the recorded measure in a way that may undermine the intended service.
C. Solving every problem more thoroughly before recording completion.
D. Removing the need for customers to receive support.
normal.explain: 關單速度提高可能犧牲真正解決問題，指標和原目標脫節。

normal.desc: 【推論】The chair said the proposal had support in principle, though several details remained unresolved. What would overstate the position?
options: A. Further discussion of implementation is still needed.
B. Support does not yet settle all practical questions.
C. The proposal has received final approval in every detail.
D. The general direction has some backing.
normal.explain: in principle 的支持不能等同細節全部定案。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：把責任或權限交付他人的過程
請唸出單字：未待指示而主動採取行動的能力
請唸出：實際可行的妥協
請唸出：明確的責任歸屬體系
請唸出：我們應釐清這項承諾的界線
normal.ans: WE SHOULD CLARIFY THE LIMITS OF THAT COMMITMENT
normal.speak: we should clarify the limits of that commitment
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD CLARIFY THE LIMITS OF THAT COMMITMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：期限與驗證要求互相衝突
normal.ans: THE DEADLINE CONFLICTS WITH THE VERIFICATION REQUIREMENT
normal.speak: the deadline conflicts with the verification requirement
normal.vocabId: R6:THE DEADLINE CONFLICTS WITH THE VERIFICATION REQUIREMENT

normal.desc: 請拼出：把計畫或決定付諸實行（I 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：經討論形成的大致共同意見（C 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：鼓勵採取某種行動的誘因（I 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：D E L E _ A T E (把責任或權限交付他人)
填空題：P R I _ R I _ I S E (依重要性排列並優先處理)
填空題：C O N _ U L _ A T _ O N (決策前徵詢意見的過程)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 要求他人承擔所有風險的命令
B. 把已確認資料刪除的程序
C. 在完全確定以前禁止提問
D. 減輕他人疑慮而給予安心的話或行動
normal.explain: reassurance 是安慰安心，不必代表能保證所有結果。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把某件事視為針對自己的批評或冒犯
B. 親手完成某項工作而不求助
C. 把公共物品帶回私人住所
D. 逐字記錄對方說過的話
normal.explain: take something personally 涉及把言行解讀為針對個人。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: give someone the benefit of the doubt
options: A. 要求對方永遠不得再犯錯
B. 在情況未明時暫作善意解讀
C. 因已有確證而宣布對方有錯
D. 把所有責任交給不在場者
normal.explain: benefit of the doubt 是未有充分反證前給予信任。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: There is no need to decide on the spot.
options: A. 不必當場作決定。
B. 必須立刻在原地作決定。
C. 只有搬到另一個地點才可決定。
D. 決定已由其他人完成。
normal.explain: on the spot 在此是立即、當場；no need 否定必要性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I was disappointed, but I can see why you made that choice.
options: A. 我已確定同意每個後續決定。
B. 我感到失望，但能理解你為何那樣選。
C. 理解原因代表我完全沒有失望。
D. 我認為你的選擇根本不可能有理由。
normal.explain: 情緒反應與理解理由是不同面向。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I do not mind changing the plan, as long as I am not the last person to hear about it.
options: A. 我希望等所有人都知道後才通知我。
B. 我已要求自己單獨決定全部安排。
C. 我不介意改計畫，只要別讓我最後才知道。
D. 我反對任何改變，不論何時通知。
normal.explain: 接受變更以適當通知為條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The offer was generous, though accepting it would leave me feeling obliged to return the favour.
options: A. 說話者要求對方立即回報自己。
B. 提議很大方，但接受會讓我覺得有回報人情的義務。
C. 提議因附帶明文收費而不算任何幫助。
D. 接受已被確定不會產生任何心理負擔。
normal.explain: 正面評價與人情負擔可同時存在，未說對方明文索取。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather know that you cannot make it than keep the evening open on the basis of a promise you are unlikely to keep.
options: A. 我已取消這次安排且不接受說明。
B. 我認為保留時間對自己完全沒有影響。
C. 我寧願確知你不能來，也不想靠不太可能履行的承諾一直留時間。
D. 我希望即使不能來也先答應以免失禮。
normal.explain: 重點是可靠資訊比禮貌但不可靠的承諾更有用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is possible to understand someone’s reasons without agreeing that those reasons justify the way they treated you.
options: A. 只要理解理由，就必須承認所有行為合理。
B. 不認同行為就表示完全沒聽懂理由。
C. 說話者主張任何人都不可能有可理解的動機。
D. 可以理解對方理由，卻不認為理由足以正當化其對待方式。
normal.explain: 理解成因與認同行為分開，避免把兩者等同。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Her calm explanation helped put the nervous newcomer at ___.
options: A. easeful
B. easily
C. easing
D. ease
normal.explain: put someone at ease 是讓人放鬆自在的固定搭配。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would rather you ___ me before borrowing the car next time.
options: A. asked
B. will ask
C. have asking
D. to ask
normal.explain: would rather＋主詞＋過去式可表對現在或未來的偏好，並非表示事情已發生。

normal.desc: 【語意】The invitation is sincere, but there is no obligation to accept. What is communicated?
options: A. The invitation has been withdrawn without explanation.
B. The person is welcome while remaining free to decline.
C. The person must attend to prove the invitation was sincere.
D. Declining has already been prohibited.
normal.explain: 真誠邀請與不強迫出席可以同時成立。

normal.desc: 【語氣】I would love to help, but I have already committed to something else. What is the most likely function?
options: A. A polite refusal based on a prior commitment.
B. An unconditional promise to help immediately.
C. A request for the listener to cancel every plan.
D. A denial that any earlier commitment exists.
normal.explain: 表達意願後以既有承諾說明無法協助，是委婉拒絕。

normal.desc: 【短文】Jo offers to pay for a shared holiday booking, provided everyone transfers their share by Sunday. One friend assumes the offer means Jo will cover the whole cost. What has been misunderstood?
options: A. Sunday has been identified as the departure date.
B. Paying upfront has been confused with paying on everyone’s behalf permanently.
C. The booking date has been mistaken for a travel destination.
D. Jo has offered to cancel the holiday for everyone.
normal.explain: 先代付款不等於全額請客；條件要求各自轉回費用。

normal.desc: 【句意】She was reluctant to bring it up, not because it was unimportant, but because she feared an argument. What explains her hesitation?
options: A. Certainty that everyone already agrees.
B. An inability to remember what the issue concerns.
C. Concern about the reaction rather than the importance of the matter.
D. A belief that the issue has no significance.
normal.explain: not because...but because... 明確區分重要性與擔心爭執。

normal.desc: 【語意】The apology was appreciated, although it did not entirely restore trust. Which statement is supported?
options: A. The apology made any future trust impossible.
B. The apology had value, but further repair was still needed.
C. The apology was rejected as wholly meaningless.
D. Trust had returned completely before the apology.
normal.explain: appreciated 肯定價值，not entirely restore 保留信任尚未完全修復。

normal.desc: 【短文】A friend says, Any evening is fine, then rejects each proposed evening because of work or family plans. What should the organiser clarify?
options: A. Whether every family plan must be cancelled.
B. Whether work has been permanently abandoned.
C. Which evenings are actually available rather than relying on the general assurance.
D. Whether the friend understands what an evening is.
normal.explain: 概括回應與具體可行性不一致，應確認實際時段。

normal.desc: 【語用】After being asked for advice, Len says, It is your decision, but I would not rush into it. What does Len do?
options: A. Take full responsibility for making the decision.
B. Insist that the decision has already been made.
C. Recommend immediate action without reflection.
D. Preserve the other person’s choice while recommending caution.
normal.explain: 先承認自主，再提出審慎建議，非替對方作主。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：會顧及他人感受與需要的
請唸出單字：因受到不公平對待而積累的不滿
請唸出：合理的界線
請唸出：表示善意的舉動
請唸出：理解理由不代表必須同意
normal.ans: UNDERSTANDING A REASON DOES NOT REQUIRE AGREEMENT
normal.speak: understanding a reason does not require agreement
normal.vocabId: R6:UNDERSTANDING A REASON DOES NOT REQUIRE AGREEMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：這個安排需要對每個人都可行
normal.ans: THE ARRANGEMENT NEEDS TO WORK FOR EVERYONE
normal.speak: the arrangement needs to work for everyone
normal.vocabId: R6:THE ARRANGEMENT NEEDS TO WORK FOR EVERYONE

normal.desc: 請拼出：有自信且不具攻擊性地表達立場的（A 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：會顧及他人感受與需要的（C 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：為減輕疑慮而給予的安心或保證（R 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：H E S I T _ T I O N (行動或表態前的猶豫)
填空題：O B L _ G A _ I O N (應履行某事的責任或義務)
填空題：A C C _ M M _ D A _ I N G (願意配合他人需要的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 尚待確認才算確定
B. 已完成最終確認而不會改變
C. 只要提出申請就自動批准
D. 必須由旅客取消才能成立
normal.explain: subject to confirmation 表仍需確認，並非已保證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在原站完成整段旅程
B. 錯過原本要轉搭的班次
C. 忘記旅途中某人的姓名
D. 取消所有後續行程
normal.explain: connection 在交通語境是銜接班次。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只用一句話簡短記錄
B. 在完全沒有任何通知的保證下
C. 在提前通知時間很短的情況下
D. 在收到完整長期計畫以後
normal.explain: at short notice 是通知距離實施很短，未必毫無通知。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The delay is frustrating, but at least the onward connection has been protected.
options: A. 說話者主要抱怨座位不夠柔軟。
B. 延誤令人挫折，但至少後續轉乘安排獲保留。
C. 後續班次已取消而沒有替代安排。
D. 沒有延誤，所以轉乘不受任何影響。
normal.explain: at least 保留較好的一面，onward connection 指後續銜接。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would book the return now rather than assume there will be places left when we arrive.
options: A. 我已確認回程永遠不需要訂位。
B. 我認為抵達時間與行程安排完全無關。
C. 我會現在先訂回程，不假定抵達後還有空位。
D. 我建議等所有空位都用完再決定。
normal.explain: 建議先處理不確定的回程供應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The room is available from three, although you are welcome to leave your bags earlier.
options: A. 寄放行李代表房間立即可以入住。
B. 三點之前旅館拒絕提供任何協助。
C. 所有行李都必須三點後才可帶到旅館。
D. 房間三點起可用，但可提早寄放行李。
normal.explain: 寄物與入住是不同服務，不能把前者當成提早入住保證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We were told the road might be closed, so we kept a second route in mind.
options: A. 我們在完全未收到提醒下取消行程。
B. 第二條路已被證明比所有路線更短。
C. 因得知道路可能封閉，我們預先考慮了另一條路。
D. 道路已確定永久關閉，所以沒有任何路可走。
normal.explain: might 保留可能，second route 是備案。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The guarantee covers the replacement service, not every expense that might result from arriving later than planned.
options: A. 保證已承諾無條件支付每種後續損失。
B. 替代服務完全不在保證範圍內。
C. 抵達較晚已被證明不可能造成任何支出。
D. 保證涵蓋替代服務，不是延後抵達可能帶來的全部費用。
normal.explain: covers 範圍須精確，不能從一項承諾擴到所有後果。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not saying the schedule is impossible; I am saying it leaves no room for the ordinary delays we should reasonably expect.
options: A. 我不是說行程不可能，而是它沒有預留合理可預期的一般延誤。
B. 行程在任何條件下都絕不可能完成。
C. 普通延誤已被安排排除而不會發生。
D. 我只是在要求每段旅程都增加一整天。
normal.explain: 區分理論可行與實務餘裕，不作絕對否定。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Passengers should ___ sufficient time for the transfer between terminals.
options: A. allow
B. permit it
C. let
D. enable
normal.explain: allow sufficient time 指預留足夠時間；其餘不能在此直接接此名詞片語表相同意思。

normal.desc: 【文法】We ___ at the station for an hour when the cancellation was finally announced.
options: A. were waited
B. had been waiting
C. have been waiting
D. will be waiting
normal.explain: 取消宣布以前已持續等待一小時，用過去完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【語意】The reservation is provisional until payment is received. What is its status?
options: A. It guarantees travel regardless of payment.
B. It can no longer be changed by either party.
C. It is not yet fully confirmed.
D. It has been permanently cancelled.
normal.explain: provisional 是暫定，until 設定轉為確定的條件。

normal.desc: 【條件】Refunds are available only for tickets cancelled before departure. Which requirement is stated?
options: A. The ticket must have been bought on the departure day.
B. Cancellation must occur before departure.
C. All tickets become refundable after the trip.
D. The traveller must choose the longest route.
normal.explain: only for 與 before 限定退費條件，不能擴張為所有票皆可退。

normal.desc: 【短文】A tour includes transport to the island but not the return ferry. The return must be booked separately, and evening places are limited. What should travellers arrange?
options: A. Cancellation of every island activity.
B. Payment only after all evening ferries have left.
C. A separate return booking rather than assuming a round trip is included.
D. A second outbound journey on the same morning.
normal.explain: 方案只包含去程，回程須另訂；這是資訊範圍理解。

normal.desc: 【語氣】The connection is possible, but I would not call it comfortable. What is the advice?
options: A. The transfer has been confirmed impossible.
B. The seats on the second train are uncomfortable.
C. The traveller is guaranteed a long break between services.
D. The transfer may work, though the available margin is limited.
normal.explain: possible 與 comfortable 在轉乘語境區分可行與餘裕充足。

normal.desc: 【推測】The road was dry before we entered the tunnel, but the cars coming from the other side were covered in rain. It ___ beyond the hill.
options: A. is to have rained it
B. has raining
C. must have been raining
D. must rain tomorrow
normal.explain: 以車輛狀況推測先前持續下雨，用 must have been raining。

normal.desc: 【短文】A train company reports that most services arrive on time. A commuter’s route is one of the few with repeated delays, and the published average combines all routes. Why may the claim not answer the commuter’s concern?
options: A. The average proves that the commuter has never been delayed.
B. Combining routes necessarily makes every arrival record false.
C. The commuter’s route is not part of any rail network.
D. A network-wide average may conceal the experience of a particular route.
normal.explain: 總體平均不能直接代表每條路線，未否定所有統計。

normal.desc: 【語用】The clerk says, We can offer a later service, but I cannot promise the same seat arrangement. What is available?
options: A. An alternative departure without a guarantee of equivalent seating.
B. The original departure with every seat unchanged.
C. A guarantee that the whole group will sit together.
D. A refusal to offer any alternative journey.
normal.explain: offer 與 cannot promise 的範圍需一起保留。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：旅程中各段安排的行程表
請唸出單字：使原本正常進行受到干擾的情況
請唸出：已有銜接保障安排的轉乘
請唸出：尚未完全確定的預訂
請唸出：這份確認不保證立即可用
normal.ans: THE CONFIRMATION DOES NOT GUARANTEE IMMEDIATE AVAILABILITY
normal.speak: the confirmation does not guarantee immediate availability
normal.vocabId: R6:THE CONFIRMATION DOES NOT GUARANTEE IMMEDIATE AVAILABILITY

normal.desc: 請唸出：我們應預留站與站之間的轉乘時間
normal.ans: WE SHOULD ALLOW FOR THE TRANSFER BETWEEN STATIONS
normal.speak: we should allow for the transfer between stations
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD ALLOW FOR THE TRANSFER BETWEEN STATIONS

normal.desc: 請拼出：旅程中各段安排的行程表（I 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：正常運作受到干擾或中斷的情況（D 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：償還他人先行支出費用的款項或過程（R 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：D E T _ U R (避開原路障礙而繞行的路線)
填空題：P R O _ I S I _ N A L (尚待確認或可能更改的暫定的)
填空題：C O _ N E _ T _ O N (旅途中銜接轉搭的班次)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 尚未有人提出的假設
B. 很容易破裂的休戰
C. 已永久化解所有敵意的協議
D. 一場完全沒有停火的戰鬥
normal.explain: fragile 指不穩固，truce 是休戰而非永久和平。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 完全不受任何人影響
B. 為了躲避所有承諾
C. 在某人的保護之下
D. 因某人的命令而受處罰
normal.explain: under the protection of 表受保護的關係。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把每個單字抄進筆記
B. 不准別人更換任何措辭
C. 只在同意時才發出聲音
D. 履行你說過的承諾
normal.explain: keep your word 是守信，不是保存文字。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We can lend you the key, provided you return before sunset.
options: A. 無論何時回來都已無條件獲准。
B. 你必須先證明太陽永不落下。
C. 只要日落前回來，就能借你鑰匙。
D. 鑰匙只可在日落後歸還且不得提早。
normal.explain: provided 引入借用條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The messenger carried an order, not an explanation, and we should not pretend it answered the villagers’ concerns.
options: A. 命令已充分說明每項決定原因。
B. 村民從未提出任何問題。
C. 只要帶有印章就不需要理解內容。
D. 信使帶來命令而非解釋，不能假裝已回應村民顧慮。
normal.explain: 有指示不等於有回應疑問的理由。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather lose an hour checking the bridge than save an hour and risk everyone’s lives.
options: A. 我寧願花一小時檢查橋，也不願省時間卻冒全隊生命危險。
B. 我建議不檢查以最快速度通過。
C. 橋已被確定不能通行，所以沒有選擇。
D. 說話者認為檢查能保證永遠不會有意外。
normal.explain: 明確比較時間成本與風險，不保證檢查消除所有風險。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The spell can reveal a hidden door, but it cannot tell us what lies beyond it.
options: A. 看見門就已知道門後完全安全。
B. 法術完全無法發現任何入口。
C. 法術已提供所有地下路線的完整地圖。
D. 法術能顯示隱藏門，卻不能告訴我們門後有什麼。
normal.explain: 資訊能力有範圍限制，發現入口不等於了解後方。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The promise sounds generous until we notice that the ruler is offering to restore a freedom he had no right to remove.
options: A. 承諾初聽大方，但其實只是恢復統治者本無權剝奪的自由。
B. 統治者原本擁有永久剝奪自由的無限權力。
C. 承諾已增加每個人原本沒有的全部特權。
D. 說話者只是在稱讚演說聲音很大。
normal.explain: 恢復既有權利與額外施惠不同，善意姿態受正當性質疑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I do not doubt that the captain wants peace; I doubt that demanding unconditional obedience is the only way to secure it.
options: A. 和平已被定義為完全不需任何協調。
B. 我不質疑隊長想要和平，只質疑無條件服從是唯一達成方法。
C. 我認為隊長已明白放棄和平。
D. 我確定所有服從都不可能有助秩序。
normal.explain: 區分目標動機與手段唯一性，非全盤否定秩序需求。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which verb means to comply with the terms of a truce? The two camps agreed to ___ the truce.
options: A. denounce
B. observe
C. breach
D. revoke
normal.explain: observe 指遵守；breach 違反，revoke 撤銷，denounce 公開譴責。

normal.desc: 【文法】The gate will remain closed until the seal ___.
options: A. will have restore
B. is restore
C. has been restored
D. has restoring
normal.explain: until 時間子句不直接用未來式；seal 是被修復，用完成式被動。

normal.desc: 【語意】The guardian offers protection, but only within the valley. Which journey falls outside the stated promise?
options: A. A journey entirely along the valley floor.
B. A visit to a village inside the valley.
C. A return to a shelter within the protected area.
D. A journey beyond the valley’s boundary.
normal.explain: only within 限定地域，越界行程不在明示承諾內。

normal.desc: 【語氣】The scout says, The path is passable, though I would not call it safe after dark. What is the distinction?
options: A. The scout guarantees that darkness removes every danger.
B. The path is safe only because nobody has used it.
C. Being able to travel along it is different from travelling without significant risk.
D. The path cannot be used at any time.
normal.explain: passable 是可通行，不必等於安全；after dark 限定風險情境。

normal.desc: 【短文】A village gives travellers shelter on condition that they leave their weapons outside. One traveller insists that being welcomed means he may carry his sword inside. What has he overlooked?
options: A. A promise that the village will provide new weapons.
B. A rule requiring travellers to leave immediately.
C. Evidence that no traveller has ever received shelter.
D. The condition attached to the welcome.
normal.explain: 歡迎附帶繳存武器條件，不能只採前半承諾。

normal.desc: 【句意】The captain refused to mistake obedience for loyalty. What did she distinguish?
options: A. Following an order from willingly supporting its source.
B. Loyalty from any possibility of helping others.
C. An order from a message with no instruction.
D. A promise from a journey already completed.
normal.explain: 服從行為不必證明內在認同忠誠。

normal.desc: 【推測】The fire was out and the camp was empty, but the kettle was still warm. The travellers ___ recently.
options: A. must leave tomorrow
B. have leaving
C. are to left
D. must have left
normal.explain: 暖水壺作過去剛離開的推測線索，用 must have left。

normal.desc: 【短文】A ruler promises that no village will be abandoned. His plan assigns a single guard to each village, regardless of size or risk. Why might residents question whether the promise is fulfilled in substance?
options: A. A token presence may not provide the meaningful protection the promise suggests.
B. The plan necessarily assigns no guard to any village.
C. Equal numbers prove that every village faces equal danger.
D. The promise explicitly guaranteed a different number to every village.
normal.explain: 名義上有人駐守不一定等於有足夠保護，未說完全無守衛。

normal.desc: 【語用】We will return what was taken, says the steward, but only after every claimant proves ownership. What remains necessary for the claimants?
options: A. Giving up ownership before making a claim.
B. Providing the required proof before receiving the promised return.
C. Accepting that nothing will ever be returned.
D. Proving that the steward personally took every item.
normal.explain: 承諾附有驗證條件，不能等同即刻無條件返還。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：對人群組織或原則的忠誠
請唸出單字：公然抗拒命令或權威的態度
請唸出：附有條件的承諾
請唸出：具有合理根據的主張
請唸出：道路開通不保證通行安全
normal.ans: AN OPEN ROAD DOES NOT GUARANTEE SAFE PASSAGE
normal.speak: an open road does not guarantee safe passage
normal.vocabId: R6:AN OPEN ROAD DOES NOT GUARANTEE SAFE PASSAGE

normal.desc: 請唸出：承諾恢復自由而非給予特權
normal.ans: THE PROMISE RESTORES A FREEDOM RATHER THAN GRANTING PRIVILEGE
normal.speak: the promise restores a freedom rather than granting privilege
normal.vocabId: R6:THE PROMISE RESTORES A FREEDOM RATHER THAN GRANTING PRIVILEGE

normal.desc: 請拼出：放棄交出權利或持有物（R 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：將受損或遭剝奪事物恢復的過程（R 開頭，11 個字母）

填空題：T R _ C E (交戰雙方暫時停止戰鬥的協議)
填空題：E V A _ U A _ I O N (把人員從危險地點撤離的行動)
填空題：S A _ C _ U _ R Y (可躲避危險而獲得庇護的地方)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只能透過購買取得的食材
B. 已經失去的味覺能力
C. 起初未必喜歡、逐漸才會欣賞的味道或事物
D. 一吃就必定人人喜歡的味道
normal.explain: acquired taste 強調透過接觸逐漸欣賞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: take it with a pinch of salt
options: A. 把那份食物徹底醃漬
B. 照字面完全相信那個說法
C. 先拒絕聽對方說完
D. 對那個說法持保留態度
normal.explain: 此慣用語指不要全盤照單全收。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 照顧不同喜好
B. 要求所有人改成同一口味
C. 測量每種食材的重量
D. 只向熟悉的人供餐
normal.explain: cater for 表滿足需求，tastes 在此指喜好。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 比預期高出很多
B. 已被訂為唯一標準
C. 沒有使用標準尺寸餐具
D. 沒有達到應有水準
normal.explain: up to standard 指達到品質要求，不是餐具尺寸。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The portions are smaller than they used to be, but the price includes a side dish now.
options: A. 份量比以前小，不過現在價格包含一份配菜。
B. 價格變低而且主菜份量變大。
C. 配菜仍須額外付費且未改變。
D. 說話者只比較餐具大小。
normal.explain: 比較同時包含主菜縮小與配菜納入，不能漏一半。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I booked for eight, meaning eight people, not eight o’clock.
options: A. 我訂了八張各坐一人的桌子。
B. 我訂的是八人位，不是八點鐘。
C. 我把八人預訂取消改成八點。
D. 我沒有提供人數也沒有提供時間。
normal.explain: 後句修正 for eight 的歧義；沒有說確切用餐時間。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The service was slow rather than unfriendly; the staff apologised and kept us informed.
options: A. 服務速度慢，不是態度不友善；員工有道歉並說明情況。
B. 員工故意不理會我們且沒有說明。
C. 餐點很快送來，但服務態度差。
D. 說話者認為道歉代表完全沒有延誤。
normal.explain: rather than 區分速度與態度，後句支持友善解讀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would recommend it for a relaxed lunch, but perhaps not for a meeting where you need to hear every word.
options: A. 推薦只適用於不需要吃飯的人。
B. 適合輕鬆午餐，但可能不適合需要聽清每句話的會議。
C. 說話者認為餐廳不適合任何午餐。
D. 餐廳已保證會議全程安靜。
normal.explain: 按使用目的作條件式推薦，暗示聲音環境限制。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The new menu gives vegetarians more choice, even though it has fewer dishes overall.
options: A. 素食菜全部取消而其他菜增加。
B. 總菜數與素食菜數被明確說成相同。
C. 新菜單總菜數減少，素食者可選的卻增加。
D. 所有客人的選擇都必然同時增加。
normal.explain: 總量與特定分類可以反向變化。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】The café can ___ guests who do not eat dairy products. Which expression means to provide suitable food for them?
options: A. look into
B. break with
C. cater for
D. count on
normal.explain: cater for 表示滿足某群人的飲食或其他需求。

normal.desc: 【文法】It was the sauce, rather than the vegetables, ___ tasted unusually sweet.
options: A. what
B. whose
C. where
D. that
normal.explain: It was ... that ... 是強調句；強調主詞 the sauce。

normal.desc: 【語用】The waiter says, We can move your table, although the window seats are all reserved. What is offered?
options: A. A different table, without a promise of a window seat.
B. The particular window seat the customer requested.
C. A cancellation of someone else’s reservation.
D. A refund instead of any possibility of moving.
normal.explain: 可以換桌，但靠窗座已預訂，不能把換桌解讀成保證靠窗。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The menu says that most dishes can be made without nuts. Which question remains unanswered?
options: A. Whether any dish can be made without nuts.
B. Whether every dish normally contains nuts, as explicitly stated.
C. Whether the menu offers food at all.
D. Which dishes cannot be adapted in that way?
normal.explain: most 不是 all，仍須確認例外；也未交代交叉接觸等安全資訊。

normal.desc: 【語意】The meal was filling without being heavy. What does the reviewer mean?
options: A. It satisfied hunger without leaving an unpleasant feeling of fullness.
B. Its weight was measured but nobody ate it.
C. It provided little food and left the reviewer hungry.
D. It was difficult to carry from the kitchen.
normal.explain: filling 指有飽足感，heavy 在餐食語境指吃後負擔重。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would prefer ___ the bill separately rather than ask everyone to transfer money later.
options: A. having pay
B. to pay
C. paying to
D. that paying
normal.explain: would prefer to do ... rather than do ...；兩個動作是付帳與事後轉帳。

normal.desc: 【語氣】The soup could do with a little more salt. Which response fits the strength of this comment?
options: A. The speaker suggests a small improvement in seasoning.
B. The speaker says the soup cannot be eaten under any circumstances.
C. The speaker asks for all the salt to be removed.
D. The speaker praises the seasoning as already ideal.
normal.explain: could do with 是委婉表示需要；a little 限定調整幅度。

normal.desc: 【短文】A reviewer praises a restaurant for using local produce. The owner points out that two imported ingredients are essential to its best-known dish. Which revision is most accurate?
options: A. Local produce cannot be used in a restaurant’s best-known dish.
B. The restaurant makes substantial use of local produce but does not use it exclusively.
C. The restaurant sources every ingredient locally.
D. The presence of two imports disproves any use of local produce.
normal.explain: 保留主要趨勢並承認例外；不用全有或全無的推論。

normal.desc: 【語用】The host says, There is plenty, but do leave some for the people coming later. How do the two parts work together?
options: A. The host confirms that everyone has already eaten.
B. The host promises unlimited supplies regardless of portions.
C. The host offers reassurance while asking guests to consider later arrivals.
D. The host withdraws the invitation to eat anything.
normal.explain: plenty 給安心感，但後句仍要求分配時顧及他人。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：熱情接待客人的態度與做法

請唸出：相當大的一份食物
請唸出：剛製作好的食物
請唸出：價格包含一份小配菜
normal.ans: THE PRICE INCLUDES A SMALL SIDE DISH
normal.speak: the price includes a small side dish
normal.vocabId: R6:THE PRICE INCLUDES A SMALL SIDE DISH

normal.desc: 請唸出：傳統食譜會隨地方而不同
normal.ans: TRADITIONAL RECIPES CAN VARY FROM PLACE TO PLACE
normal.speak: traditional recipes can vary from place to place
normal.vocabId: R6:TRADITIONAL RECIPES CAN VARY FROM PLACE TO PLACE

normal.desc: 請拼出：想吃東西的食慾（A 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：製作某道食物所用的一種食材（I 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：滋味豐富而好吃的（F 開頭，10 個字母；字數依主要拼字，亦接受標準變體）
填空題：C U I _ I N E (某地區或文化的烹飪風格)

填空題：P _ R _ I _ N (分給一人食用的一份食物)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 熄燈後的深夜
B. 第一次打開手電筒時
C. 正午光線最強時
D. 黎明天剛亮時
normal.explain: at first light 是黎明時段。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 保持距離
B. 把行程距離縮短
C. 走到對方緊貼身旁
D. 把位置交給別人
normal.explain: keep your distance 指不要靠得太近。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因為遲到而離開比賽
B. 遠離一般人常走的路線
C. 緊貼熱門主幹道
D. 已被踩成完全平坦的跑道
normal.explain: 此表達指偏僻或不常被遊訪的地方。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 進入視野而看得見
B. 逐漸被所有人同意
C. 完全從記憶中消失
D. 在討論中改變意見
normal.explain: come into view 描述開始可見。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The clearing is sheltered from the wind, though the ground stays wet long after the rain has stopped.
options: A. 說話者表示空地完全沒有下過雨。
B. 空地避風，但雨停很久後地面仍濕。
C. 空地很乾燥卻始終強風不斷。
D. 雨一停地面就立刻變乾。
normal.explain: 優點與限制並存，sheltered 不表示地面乾燥。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Please record what you actually see, and put any guesses in a separate column.
options: A. 只要猜測合理就當作親眼所見。
B. 所有欄位都必須填同一句話。
C. 請記錄實際所見，把推測放另一欄。
D. 請刪掉全部觀察只留下猜測。
normal.explain: 要求區分觀察與推測，不是完全禁止推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: That sound could be a bird, but I would rather check than put a name to it yet.
options: A. 說話者拒絕記錄任何聲音。
B. 那可能是鳥聲，但我想確認後再辨認名稱。
C. 說話者已確定是哪一種鳥。
D. 只要聽到聲音就不必檢查。
normal.explain: could 表可能；暫緩定名而非否認聲音存在。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The visitor centre is nearby as the crow flies, but the path follows the river, so allow more time than the map suggests.
options: A. 中心只准烏鴉進入而不接待人。
B. 說話者建議忽略步道直接涉水。
C. 遊客中心直線距離近，但步道沿河，應預留比地圖觀感更多的時間。
D. 步道與直線距離完全相同。
normal.explain: as the crow flies 是直線距離，不等於可走路程。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Seeing fewer birds today does not necessarily mean there are fewer in the area; they may simply be harder to spot.
options: A. 今天的觀察已證明鳥數必然下降。
B. 鳥只要存在就一定會被看見。
C. 說話者確定區內的鳥已全部離開。
D. 今天看見較少鳥，不一定代表區內鳥較少，也可能比較難發現。
normal.explain: 區分可偵測性與實際數量，may 提供替代可能。

normal.desc: 【文法】By the time we reached the clearing, the mist ___.
options: A. has lifting
B. was lift
C. did lifted
D. had lifted
normal.explain: 抵達是過去時間點，霧在此前已散，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to blend into the surroundings so that something is less easily seen?
options: A. camouflage
B. illuminate
C. isolate
D. display
normal.explain: camouflage 是偽裝以融入環境；其他詞分別照亮、隔離、展示。

normal.desc: 【語意】The path is slippery in places. What does in places tell walkers?
options: A. Every section is equally slippery.
B. Some sections of the path are slippery.
C. The whole path has been closed.
D. The path is slippery only on a map.
normal.explain: in places 指某些地段，不是全線同樣情況。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The notice says that access is restricted during the nesting season. What does it explicitly establish?
options: A. There are limits on access during a particular period.
B. The reserve is permanently closed throughout the year.
C. Every species nests at the same time.
D. Walking outside the reserve is prohibited.
normal.explain: during 限定期間；restricted 不必是完全封閉。

normal.desc: 【短文】Two groups visit the same pond. One watches at dawn, the other at midday. They report different numbers of birds. What should be considered before concluding that one group counted badly?
options: A. A difference in counts proves that neither group saw birds.
B. The time of observation may affect which birds are present.
C. Both groups must have used the same counting method.
D. The pond must have changed its location.
normal.explain: 觀察時段不同可影響出現數，不能直接歸因計數失誤。

normal.desc: 【文法】I wish I ___ the camera before leaving home; the battery is flat.
options: A. have charging
B. was charge
C. had charged
D. would charge yesterday
normal.explain: 對已發生的過去表遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【短文】A volunteer marks a flower on a map but does not pick it. Later, another visitor assumes that the absence of a specimen means no record exists. What has the visitor overlooked?
options: A. A record counts only if the plant has been moved.
B. An observation can be documented without removing the plant.
C. The volunteer has explicitly denied seeing the flower.
D. Every map must include a pressed flower.
normal.explain: 地圖標註也是紀錄，未採集不等於未記錄。

normal.desc: 【短文】After a week of rain, a stream is deeper than it was on the group’s previous visit. The guide warns against calling this its normal depth. Why?
options: A. Rainfall proves that all earlier measurements were false.
B. A stream has exactly the same depth at every location and time.
C. A recent unusual condition may make the current observation unrepresentative.
D. The current depth cannot be observed at all.
normal.explain: 近期降雨可能影響代表性，未否認當下深度真實。

normal.desc: 【語用】I have not seen a fox here, which is different from saying there are none. What distinction is made?
options: A. The speaker has confirmed a fox lives in every nearby field.
B. The speaker cannot remember the name of the animal.
C. Any claim about animal presence must be false.
D. Not observing an animal does not establish that it is absent.
normal.explain: 未觀察到與證明不存在不同。

normal.speak: the path follows the river rather than a straight line
normal.vocabId: R6:THE PATH FOLLOWS THE RIVER RATHER THAN A STRAIGHT LINE

normal.desc: 請拼出：使事物融入周遭而不易被察覺（C 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：腳踩在地面留下的印痕（F 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：植物的葉子總稱（F 開頭，7 個字母）
