填空題：M I _ R _ T _ O N (動物季節性或定期遷移的行為)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 各方有公平競爭條件
B. 只能在平坦草地比賽
C. 所有參賽者實力相同
D. 比賽必須以平手結束
normal.explain: 比喻公平條件，不保證實力或結果相等。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已正式退出所屬球隊
B. 因久未練習而生疏
C. 練習量多到過度疲勞
D. 正在場外觀看練習
normal.explain: out of practice 指技巧生疏，不等於退隊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 決定不再嘗試
B. 等別人替自己完成
C. 逐漸掌握做法
D. 把東西掛到架上
normal.explain: get the hang of 是掌握操作或技巧。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在場地轉彎
B. 輪流進行
C. 一起同時開始
D. 改變活動方向
normal.explain: take turns 是輪替，不是一起做。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You do not need to be fast, but you do need to be comfortable cycling for an hour.
options: A. 只要騎得快就不必騎滿時段。
B. 活動只有一小時的騎車教學。
C. 不用騎得快，但需能自在騎一小時。
D. 必須以最快速度騎完一小時。
normal.explain: 速度非條件，持續騎乘的適應程度才是條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We lost on points, though we won more individual games than they did.
options: A. 我們總分較高，但贏的場次較少。
B. 雙方總分與勝場都一樣。
C. 比賽只有一場而我們輸了。
D. 我們總分輸了，儘管贏的個別場次較多。
normal.explain: 總分與勝場數是不同計分層次。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The booking is for the court, not for a lesson, so nobody will be there to coach us.
options: A. 只有教練能用我們預約的場地。
B. 教練已取消原本包含的課程。
C. 預約的是場地而非課程，所以不會有教練教我們。
D. 預約包括場地和一堂教練課。
normal.explain: not for a lesson 說明原安排，非臨時取消。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She makes it look easy, which is probably why people underestimate how much practice goes into it.
options: A. 她不用練習，所以表現總是輕鬆。
B. 旁人認為她練太多而影響表現。
C. 她刻意讓技巧看起來比實際更難。
D. 她做得看似輕鬆，可能使人低估背後練習量。
normal.explain: 表現自然不等於不需練習；probably 保留推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not call it cheating, but I can see why the others felt it went against the spirit of the game.
options: A. 我不會稱為作弊，但理解其他人為何覺得違背遊戲精神。
B. 我確認對方違反明文規則，理應受罰。
C. 我認為其他人已接受這種做法。
D. 我無法理解其他人為何在意此事。
normal.explain: 區分明文作弊定性與精神層面的不滿。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which expression means to stop playing fairly because the result seems impossible to change? The team must not ___ before the final whistle.
options: A. give up
B. warm up
C. turn up
D. sign up
normal.explain: give up 放棄；warm up 暖身、turn up 出現、sign up 報名。

normal.desc: 【文法】You can borrow a racket as long as you ___ it before closing time.
options: A. have return
B. return
C. will returning
D. returned it
normal.explain: as long as 表條件，談未來用現在式 return。

normal.desc: 【語意】The club welcomes beginners but asks players to bring their own shoes. What is provided by this statement?
options: A. A restriction to experienced competitors.
B. A requirement to buy shoes from the club.
C. An invitation with a practical requirement.
D. A promise to lend all necessary clothing.
normal.explain: 歡迎初學者並不取消自備鞋子的要求，也未限定購買處。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective means decided beforehand rather than arranged at the last moment?
options: A. improvised
B. prearranged
C. unplanned
D. spontaneous
normal.explain: prearranged 指預先安排；其他詞表示未先規劃。

normal.desc: 【短文】A club charges an entry fee but lends equipment at no extra cost. A visitor assumes that borrowing a racket makes the whole visit free. What has been confused?
options: A. The right to borrow with the right to buy.
B. The opening time with the booking period.
C. The cost of equipment with the cost of entry.
D. The entry charge with a refundable deposit.
normal.explain: 器材免加價不等於入場免費。

normal.desc: 【文法】If I had known the session was outdoors, I ___ a warmer jacket.
options: A. will have brought
B. had bringing
C. would bring yesterday
D. would have brought
normal.explain: 對過去未實現條件，用 if had known / would have brought。

normal.desc: 【短文】A competition ranks teams by points. If points are equal, fewer penalties decides the order. Two teams have equal points, but one has fewer penalties. Which rule applies?
options: A. Ignore penalties because the points are equal.
B. Ask which team joined the competition first.
C. Use the penalty count to break the tie.
D. Award extra points for the lower penalty count.
normal.explain: 題幹給同分排序規則；不是改寫得分。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am happy to take part, provided nobody expects me to keep up with the regular runners. What is the speaker doing?
options: A. Declining until the regular runners leave the club.
B. Promising to match the fastest regular runner.
C. Asking the club to stop recording everyone’s times.
D. Agreeing while setting a limit on expectations.
normal.explain: 同意參與但要求調整對自身表現的期待。

normal.desc: 【短文】The organisers say the event is not a race, yet display everyone’s finishing order on a large screen. Some participants feel competitive pressure. What explains their reaction?
options: A. The public comparison may conflict with the stated emphasis on participation.
B. The organisers have announced that slower participants cannot return.
C. The participants have misunderstood the difference between screens and clocks.
D. The event must have awarded cash prizes according to finishing order.
normal.explain: 公開排名可產生競爭壓力，不必已有獎金或淘汰規則。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：競賽中公平尊重他人的運動精神
請唸出單字：持續進行體力或心力活動的耐力
請唸出：彼此友善但有競爭的關係
請唸出：兼顧雙方的公平折衷
請唸出：公平結果不必是相等結果
normal.ans: A FAIR RESULT NEED NOT BE AN EQUAL RESULT
normal.speak: a fair result need not be an equal result
normal.vocabId: R6:A FAIR RESULT NEED NOT BE AN EQUAL RESULT

normal.desc: 請唸出：定期練習能讓難技巧看似容易
normal.ans: REGULAR PRACTICE CAN MAKE A DIFFICULT SKILL LOOK EASY
normal.speak: regular practice can make a difficult skill look easy
normal.vocabId: R6:REGULAR PRACTICE CAN MAKE A DIFFICULT SKILL LOOK EASY

normal.desc: 請拼出：用來擊球的球拍（R 開頭，6 個字母；字數依主要拼字，亦接受標準變體）
請拼出：由多場比賽組成的錦標賽（T 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：使身體動作配合的協調能力（C 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：U M P _ R E (某些運動中執行規則的裁判)
填空題：S P E _ T A _ O R (觀看活動或比賽的觀眾)
填空題：F _ X _ U _ E (預定舉行的一場體育賽事)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必須逐字公開播出的內容
B. 不供公開引用或報導
C. 已正式列入公開紀錄
D. 因錄音結束而停止說話
normal.explain: off the record 是消息使用條件，不只錄音開關狀態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 估算紙張印刷所需的價格
B. 核對說話者的臉部照片
C. 依表面意思接受而不多作懷疑
D. 從未明說的地方推敲隱意
normal.explain: take at face value 指照表面價值或意思接受。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把錄音檔排成直線
B. 刪掉所有原始紀錄
C. 正式結束一場比賽
D. 澄清已被誤解的事實
normal.explain: put the record straight 指釐清事實。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 由兩種語言組成的每一則訊息
B. 因檔案格式不同而不能開啟的信
C. 傳達彼此不一致暗示的訊息
D. 同時寄給不同人的同一封信
normal.explain: mixed message 核心是訊號或立場不一致，不是混合語言。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I meant to warn you that the time might change, not tell you that the event had been cancelled.
options: A. 我已宣布活動取消，只是尚未決定退款時間。
B. 活動時間確定不變，只有場地可能更換。
C. 我原想取消活動，但現在決定照常舉行。
D. 我想提醒時間可能變，不是說活動已取消。
normal.explain: 區分可能改期與已取消，兩者確定度與內容不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The quotation is accurate as far as it goes, but the next sentence changes how I would understand it.
options: A. 引文所引部分正確，但下一句會改變我對它的理解。
B. 引文有字詞錯誤，下一句則逐字正確。
C. 下一句已證明被引述的人沒有說過這些話。
D. 引文和下一句完全無關，只是格式不同。
normal.explain: 字面引用正確仍可能脈絡不足。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The update confirms the venue, but we are still waiting for a definite starting time.
options: A. 更新已確認時間，地點則仍在商議。
B. 更新宣布時間地點一律依原訂安排。
C. 地點已取消，時間則由參加者自行選擇。
D. 更新確認了地點，但確定開始時間仍待通知。
normal.explain: 確認事項僅場地，時間未定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not assume she agrees just because she has not replied; she may not have seen the message.
options: A. 別因她未回覆就認定同意，她可能沒看見訊息。
B. 她未回覆已表明反對，只是不好意思直說。
C. 她已看過訊息，所以沉默必定表示同意。
D. 說話者確認她看過後決定不再參加。
normal.explain: 提出未讀作替代解釋，沒有斷言她必定未讀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It sounds more definite in the summary than it did when he actually said it.
options: A. 原話與摘要用相同措辭表達同等確定度。
B. 摘要的語氣比他原本說話更確定。
C. 原話比摘要更堅定，摘要加入太多保留。
D. 摘要新增的細節已使原話得到證實。
normal.explain: 比較表達確定度，不是判斷內容真假已定。

normal.desc: 【文法】The presenter said that the interview ___ the previous evening.
options: A. was been recorded
B. had been recorded
C. has been recording
D. will record
normal.explain: 轉述中 the previous evening 指過去另一事件前，用過去完成式被動。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to publicly withdraw a statement because it is no longer supported?
options: A. illustrate
B. circulate
C. retract
D. repeat
normal.explain: retract 是撤回聲明；repeat 重複、illustrate 說明、circulate 流傳。

normal.desc: 【語意】The editor asks for a brief account of the meeting. What is requested?
options: A. A detailed record of every spoken word.
B. A prediction of what the next meeting will decide.
C. A list of people who refused to attend.
D. A concise description of what happened.
normal.explain: brief account 是簡短敘述，不是逐字稿或未來預測。

normal.desc: 【範圍】A notice says the service may be interrupted on Friday. Which paraphrase preserves its certainty?
options: A. The service will stop for the whole of Friday.
B. The service has already stopped this Friday.
C. An interruption is possible on Friday.
D. An interruption is scheduled for every Friday.
normal.explain: may 是可能，未說必然、整天或每週。

normal.desc: 【短文】A headline says a proposal has been approved. The article says only that a committee has agreed to discuss it. What needs correcting?
options: A. The committee has been presented as a single person.
B. A completed discussion has been presented as a future one.
C. The proposal has been presented as already rejected.
D. Discussion has been presented as approval.
normal.explain: agree to discuss 不等於 approve，標題提高決策進度。

normal.desc: 【文法】The email was so badly worded that I could not tell ___ the request was urgent.
options: A. whether
B. which
C. whose
D. unless
normal.explain: tell whether ... 表辨別是否；urgent 是待判定狀態。

normal.desc: 【短文】A photograph shows a crowded hall, but its caption gives neither the event nor the date. A reader uses it to support a claim about yesterday’s meeting. What is missing?
options: A. Evidence that a hall can accommodate a crowd.
B. A count of the chairs visible in the background.
C. The names of everyone who attended yesterday.
D. Confirmation that the photograph depicts that meeting.
normal.explain: 需先確認照片對應所稱事件；其他資訊非此關鍵。

normal.desc: 【語用】I can see why you read it that way, though I am not sure that is what she intended. What is the speaker doing?
options: A. Acknowledging a reading while questioning the intended meaning.
B. Accepting that the writer deliberately chose to offend the reader.
C. Denying that the reader could reasonably interpret the words that way.
D. Asking the writer to use exactly the same words in a new message.
normal.explain: 理解讀者解讀有由，不代表確定作者意圖如此。

normal.desc: 【短文】A presenter calls a clip unedited. The clip is continuous, but begins after the speaker has explained the condition attached to an offer. What distinction matters?
options: A. An unedited extract is necessarily longer than the original.
B. An uninterrupted extract may still omit relevant context.
C. A continuous extract must show a different speaker.
D. An omitted condition proves the offer was withdrawn.
normal.explain: 片段內未剪接不等於包含前後全部脈絡。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：為圖片提供說明的文字
請唸出單字：正式撤回先前聲明的行動
請唸出：容易使人誤解內容的標題
請唸出：理解內容所需的完整脈絡
請唸出：禮貌回覆不一定表示同意
normal.ans: A POLITE REPLY DOES NOT NECESSARILY EXPRESS AGREEMENT
normal.speak: a polite reply does not necessarily express agreement
normal.vocabId: R6:A POLITE REPLY DOES NOT NECESSARILY EXPRESS AGREEMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：摘要聽起來比原文確定
normal.ans: THE SUMMARY SOUNDS MORE DEFINITE THAN THE ORIGINAL
normal.speak: the summary sounds more definite than the original
normal.vocabId: R6:THE SUMMARY SOUNDS MORE DEFINITE THAN THE ORIGINAL

normal.desc: 請拼出：正式撤回先前說法（R 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：向大眾播送的節目（B 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：避免明確表態或承諾的（N 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：R U M _ U R (流傳但未獲證實的說法)
填空題：T R A _ S C _ I P T (將口頭內容寫下的逐字紀錄)
填空題：P U _ L _ C _ T Y (使人或事受到大眾注意的宣傳)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把房子改建成新樣式
B. 獨自負擔全部家務
C. 像在自己家般自在
D. 立刻返回自己的住處
normal.explain: 招待客人時意為放輕鬆自在。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 專門進行裝修的房間
B. 已達到不需修改的程度
C. 因房間太大而無法維護
D. 仍有可以改善之處
normal.explain: room 比喻空間或餘地，不必是實體房間。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 暫時解決問題的辦法
B. 一次完成的永久翻新
C. 固定不再更動的規則
D. 仍未開始討論的計畫
normal.explain: temporary fix 緩解眼前問題，不保證長久處理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 共用一把遮雨傘
B. 屋頂只能使用一種材料
C. 所有人都睡同一張床
D. 住在或位於同一建築內
normal.explain: under one roof 指同一屋簷下，不必同房。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We can move the desk, but I would check that the door still opens fully before settling on that corner.
options: A. 可搬桌子，但選定那個角落前我會確認門能全開。
B. 桌子已搬好，所以門現在確定能全開。
C. 說話者主張不管門是否受阻都用那個角落。
D. 說話者要求拆門之後才能討論搬桌子。
normal.explain: 建議先檢查空間相容性，非已確認結果或施工要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I agreed to look after the plants while you were away, not to reorganise the whole balcony.
options: A. 我已把植物重新擺好，只剩陽台地板。
B. 我答應你不在時照顧植物，不是重整整個陽台。
C. 我答應重整陽台，但沒有答應碰植物。
D. 我原本拒絕幫忙，現在才同意照顧植物。
normal.explain: 區分同意任務的範圍。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The repair looks neat, though we have not yet had enough rain to see whether it has solved the leak.
options: A. 修補外觀看來整齊，但雨還不夠多，未能驗證是否止漏。
B. 修補已經歷大雨，因此確認完全不漏。
C. 修補因外觀不整齊而被確定無效。
D. 只要外觀整齊，就不必再看下雨情況。
normal.explain: 外觀品質與功能驗證不同，未提供施工建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is not the mess itself that bothers me so much as never knowing who is expected to deal with it.
options: A. 我已決定只要不是自己整理就不再介意。
B. 比起凌亂本身，更困擾我的是不知該由誰處理。
C. 最困擾我的是東西多，責任分配倒很清楚。
D. 我不在意由誰處理，只要求立刻購買新收納櫃。
normal.explain: not ... so much as ... 比較困擾來源，重點在責任不明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The room feels more spacious now, even though we have actually added a small table.
options: A. 多放桌子使房間比以前更擁擠。
B. 房間只是看來更大，家具其實全移除了。
C. 房間現在感覺更寬敞，儘管實際多放一張小桌。
D. 房間擴建後才有空間放原來那張大桌。
normal.explain: 空間感與家具件數不必反向連動，未說擴建。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which expression means to delay starting a task? We cannot ___ cleaning the storeroom any longer.
options: A. set up
B. take over
C. put off
D. clear out
normal.explain: put off 延後；clear out 清空、set up 設立、take over 接手。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would rather you ___ before moving my things next time.
options: A. will ask
B. have asking
C. to ask
D. asked
normal.explain: would rather + 不同主詞 + 過去式，表對現在或未來的偏好。

normal.desc: 【語意】The room is compact rather than cramped. What is the intended positive distinction?
options: A. It is small but does not feel uncomfortably crowded.
B. It is large but has been filled with too much furniture.
C. It is small because it has not yet been decorated.
D. It is crowded but easier to heat than a larger room.
normal.explain: compact 緊湊可含正面意味；cramped 是擁擠侷促。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective describes a surface that is not level or smooth?
options: A. upright
B. unoccupied
C. waterproof
D. uneven
normal.explain: uneven 不平整；upright 直立、unoccupied 無人用、waterproof 防水。

normal.desc: 【短文】A notice asks residents not to leave bicycles in the hallway, but provides a rack in the courtyard. A resident says bicycles have been banned from the building’s grounds. What is overstated?
options: A. A location-specific restriction has become a general ban.
B. An optional storage suggestion has become a required purchase.
C. A rule about bicycles has become a rule about cars.
D. A temporary closure has become a permanent repair.
normal.explain: 走廊禁放不等於全院禁止，另有停車架。

normal.desc: 【文法】The cupboard needs ___, but we can leave the painting until later.
options: A. repair itself
B. repairing
C. to repairing
D. have repaired
normal.explain: need doing 表某物需要被處理，cupboard needs repairing。

normal.desc: 【短文】One housemate agrees to clean the kitchen if another clears the table first. The table remains covered. What is the most accurate description?
options: A. The condition attached to the cleaning agreement has not been met.
B. The housemate has refused to do any cleaning under any circumstances.
C. The table must be cleared only after the kitchen has been cleaned.
D. The agreement gives the second housemate responsibility for every room.
normal.explain: if ... first 設先行條件，不是無條件拒絕清潔。

normal.desc: 【語用】I do not mind the music, just not at a volume that fills every room. What is being challenged?
options: A. The use of speakers rather than headphones specifically.
B. Its loudness rather than its presence.
C. Its musical style rather than its loudness.
D. The time it starts rather than the room it fills.
normal.explain: 不反對音樂本身，只反對音量影響全部房間；未限定器材。

normal.desc: 【短文】A flat is described as newly decorated. The visitor notices freshly painted walls but worn plumbing fittings. Which conclusion is warranted?
options: A. The worn fittings establish that none of the walls has been repainted.
B. The visitor has proved that the flat has never undergone any maintenance.
C. The description does not by itself establish that every fitting has been replaced.
D. The description guarantees that all hidden systems have been renewed.
normal.explain: 裝飾翻新不等於所有設備更換；不推論隱藏系統狀態。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：凌亂堆放而使空間擁擠的物品
請唸出單字：使建物或物品維持良好狀態的保養
請唸出：由多人共同承擔的責任
請唸出：令人高興的改變
請唸出：整齊外觀不證明修補有效
normal.ans: A TIDY APPEARANCE DOES NOT PROVE THE REPAIR WORKS
normal.speak: a tidy appearance does not prove the repair works
normal.vocabId: R6:A TIDY APPEARANCE DOES NOT PROVE THE REPAIR WORKS

normal.desc: 請唸出：搬東西前應先同意改動
normal.ans: WE SHOULD AGREE ON CHANGES BEFORE MOVING THINGS
normal.speak: we should agree on changes before moving things
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD AGREE ON CHANGES BEFORE MOVING THINGS

normal.desc: 請拼出：維持設備建物良好狀態的保養（M 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：有門的收納櫃（C 開頭，8 個字母）

填空題：F U R N I _ H I N G (家具或窗簾等室內擺設物)
填空題：T H R _ S H _ L D (門口下方跨過的門檻)
填空題：W _ R _ T _ P (廚房等供作業使用的檯面)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把工具正式借給別人
B. 要求別人接手全部工作
C. 把責任轉交而不再參與
D. 幫忙出一份力
normal.explain: lend a hand 是提供協助。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 隨時準備在需要時接手
B. 已確定不再提供任何服務
C. 站在固定位置等待拍照
D. 正式接任全部工作直到結束
normal.explain: on standby 是待命可用，不等於已接手。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在預訂截止前的最後一天
B. 在活動舉行當天
C. 在公告發出的那一天固定時刻
D. 在任何白天而非夜晚
normal.explain: 活動語境的 on the day 通常指活動當天。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 大約的人數統計
B. 只計算主辦人而排除來賓
C. 已逐一核對身份的精確名單
D. 以身高排序而成的隊伍
normal.explain: rough 表大略；headcount 人數。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have enough people to open the stalls, but not enough to keep every stall open all afternoon.
options: A. 人數充足，所以每人都可以提早離開。
B. 人手足以開攤，但不足以讓每攤整個下午都開。
C. 每攤整個下午都有人，但無人負責開場。
D. 所有攤位已因人手不足取消。
normal.explain: 開始營運與持續覆蓋是不同人力要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I can cover the first hour if someone takes over at eleven, because I cannot stay any later.
options: A. 即使沒人接手，我也能留下直到活動結束。
B. 我已安排好十一點的接手人，無需再找。
C. 若十一點有人接手，我能顧第一小時，之後不能留。
D. 我會從十一點起接手，但只做最後一小時。
normal.explain: 條件是有人接班，未說已找到接班者。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The room is booked until five, which means we need to finish clearing up by then, not just finish the talk.
options: A. 房間已續訂，所以演講可以晚些結束。
B. 房間訂到五點，代表收拾也要在那時完成。
C. 演講五點開始，收拾時間則另外計算。
D. 只要演講五點結束，收拾多久都不限。
normal.explain: by then 的範圍包括清場，不只節目。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am glad everyone is willing to help; I would be even happier if we knew which jobs each person had actually agreed to do.
options: A. 說話者認為願意幫忙就表示同意所有任務。
B. 說話者不信任任何人，因而取消全部分工。
C. 很高興大家肯幫忙，但更希望清楚每人已同意的工作。
D. 大家已分工清楚，所以現在只需再招更多人。
normal.explain: 肯定意願並指出任務承諾尚不明確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The plan works if the weather stays dry, so we should not describe it as settled until we have an alternative.
options: A. 乾天方案已定，因此備案只需活動後再想。
B. 說話者確認天氣預報保證整天不下雨。
C. 備案必須與乾天方案內容完全一致。
D. 乾天才可行，沒有備案前不宜說計畫已定。
normal.explain: 有條件可行與整體準備完備不同。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which expression means to take responsibility for a task? Could you ___ checking the guest list?
options: A. make up for
B. put up with
C. look back on
D. take charge of
normal.explain: take charge of 是負責；其餘為彌補、忍受、回顧。

normal.desc: 【文法】Please let us know by Thursday whether you ___ to attend on Saturday.
options: A. will be able
B. were being able
C. have able
D. will can
normal.explain: 未來能否出席用 will be able to；can 不能與 will 並用。

normal.desc: 【語意】Volunteers may choose a morning or afternoon shift, but not both. What is offered?
options: A. A guarantee that both periods have equal workloads.
B. A choice between two periods of duty.
C. Permission to split each shift into two halves.
D. A requirement to work throughout the whole day.
normal.explain: or ... but not both 明示二擇一，不保證工作量相同。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which noun refers to a person who is present at an event?
options: A. attendee
B. applicant
C. organiser
D. nominee
normal.explain: attendee 是出席者；其他為申請者、主辦者、被提名者。

normal.desc: 【短文】An invitation asks guests to reply even if they cannot attend. A guest says silence will be understood as a refusal. What has the guest overlooked?
options: A. The invitation gives a different reply deadline to each guest.
B. The request includes people who will not attend.
C. The event requires every invitee to bring another guest.
D. The organisers have already assumed everyone will attend.
normal.explain: even if cannot attend 仍須回覆，不應以沉默代替。

normal.desc: 【文法】We will have the chairs ___ before the doors open.
options: A. to arranging
B. arrange them
C. arranged
D. arranging
normal.explain: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞 表安排某物被處理；chairs 被排好。

normal.desc: 【短文】A volunteer offers to distribute leaflets, not design them. The organiser later criticises her for failing to produce a layout. What should be checked?
options: A. Whether distribution must always follow the same route.
B. Whether the expected task matches the task she accepted.
C. Whether leaflets are usually printed in colour.
D. Whether more than one person may attend the event.
normal.explain: 分發與設計是不同任務，需核對承諾範圍。

normal.desc: 【語用】That should be manageable, as long as the numbers do not change again. How firm is the agreement?
options: A. It confirms that further changes have already been approved.
B. It guarantees success even if attendance rises sharply.
C. It is positive but depends on the numbers remaining stable.
D. It is a refusal to manage the event regardless of numbers.
normal.explain: should 與 as long as 合成有條件的可行評估。

normal.desc: 【短文】A workshop has ten places. The organiser keeps two for people unable to book online. A website shows eight bookable places. A visitor calls this evidence that two places have already been sold. What is missing?
options: A. The total capacity must exclude all visitors who use the website.
B. The workshop has promised to increase capacity by two places.
C. The organiser has withdrawn the two places from the event entirely.
D. Not all unavailable places represent completed bookings.
normal.explain: 保留名額與已售出不同；題幹已給保留原因。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：列出人員與工作安排的名單
請唸出單字：可能發生而需要預作準備的情況
請唸出：能力範圍內可應付的工作量
請唸出：仍可能調整的暫定時程
請唸出：願幫忙的志工未同意所有任務
normal.ans: A WILLING VOLUNTEER HAS NOT AGREED TO EVERY TASK
normal.speak: a willing volunteer has not agreed to every task
normal.vocabId: R6:A WILLING VOLUNTEER HAS NOT AGREED TO EVERY TASK

normal.desc: 請唸出：預訂時段包含所需清場時間
normal.ans: THE BOOKING PERIOD INCLUDES THE TIME NEEDED FOR CLEARING UP
normal.speak: the booking period includes the time needed for clearing up
normal.vocabId: R6:THE BOOKING PERIOD INCLUDES THE TIME NEEDED FOR CLEARING UP

normal.desc: 請拼出：活動的出席者（A 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：把工作或權限委派他人（D 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：償還他人已代墊的費用（R 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：B A _ G E (表示身份或角色的小牌子)
填空題：V _ N _ E (活動舉行的場地)
填空題：R E G _ S T _ A T _ O N (登記參加的程序)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 回想過往的懷舊經驗
B. 實際沿著名為記憶的小路散步
C. 對未來旅行作詳細預測
D. 完全忘記曾經到過的地方
normal.explain: 此慣用語指重溫往事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 標示哪裡可以購買衣物
B. 出現使用磨損的痕跡
C. 展示穿衣服的操作步驟
D. 被確認從未使用過
normal.explain: wear 作名詞可指磨損。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已失去原有形狀
B. 只剩下零散配件
C. 保存完好而幾乎如新
D. 帶有薄荷味道
normal.explain: mint condition 指狀態近全新，不是氣味。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The original is kept upstairs; this is the copy visitors are allowed to handle.
options: A. 複本已遺失，所以改讓遊客觸摸原件。
B. 原件放樓上，這是讓遊客觸摸的複本。
C. 這是原件，樓上的複本禁止觸摸。
D. 遊客可把樓上原件帶走，複本則留此處。
normal.explain: 區分展示用複本與原件的存放用途。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I had remembered the room as enormous, but of course I was only six the last time I saw it.
options: A. 說話者六年前才來，因此記憶必然完全準確。
B. 說話者已忘記房間，無法描述任何印象。
C. 我記得房間很大，不過上次看見時我才六歲。
D. 房間已被確定擴建，所以現在比記憶大。
normal.explain: 年齡視角可能影響大小記憶，未明說物理改建。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The date on the frame tells us when it was presented, not necessarily when the picture was painted.
options: A. 框上日期已確定是畫作與框都製成的同一天。
B. 畫作年代比贈送日期晚，所以日期必定偽造。
C. 日期只說明照片沖洗時間，與贈送無關。
D. 框上的日期是贈送時間，不一定是畫作完成時間。
normal.explain: 同一物件可有不同相關日期，不能直接互代。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Please do not straighten the bent handle; the bend is part of the story we are trying to preserve.
options: A. 故事證明把手本來就是直的，彎曲是誤會。
B. 說話者只反對拍攝把手，並未談修整。
C. 別把彎把手弄直，那彎曲是我們想保留的故事一部分。
D. 把手已被矯直，所以需要重新弄彎。
normal.explain: 保存使用痕跡而非只追求整齊，非實際維修建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I know it is not rare, but rarity is not really the point when it is the one I remember from our kitchen.
options: A. 它必定非常稀有，所以我才記得家裡有它。
B. 只要新物件更罕見，就能完全取代原有回憶。
C. 說話者不記得來處，只在乎轉售價值。
D. 我知道它不罕見，但它是記憶中家裡那件，重點不在稀有。
normal.explain: 個人物件連結不同於市場稀有性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The label says unknown maker, which is more honest than attaching the name of someone whose work merely looks similar.
options: A. 標籤寫作者不詳，比只因相似就冠上某人姓名更誠實。
B. 相似外觀已足以確認作者，因此不詳標籤不誠實。
C. 標籤承認作者不詳，表示物件沒有任何價值。
D. 說話者建議選最有名的相似作者來吸引遊客。
normal.explain: 相似不足以確定歸屬，承認未知可更準確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The photograph shows the house ___ my grandparents used to live.
options: A. where
B. which in
C. whose
D. what
normal.explain: where 引出居住地點；若用 which 應是 in which 或 which ... in。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which noun means an object kept because it reminds someone of a person or occasion?
options: A. receipt
B. keepsake
C. replica
D. toolkit
normal.explain: keepsake 是紀念物；replica 複製品、toolkit 工具組、receipt 收據。

normal.desc: 【語意】The display contains a replica of the original key. What is on display?
options: A. A photograph showing where the key was lost.
B. A damaged key whose shape cannot be recognised.
C. A copy made to resemble the original key.
D. The only key ever used to open the building.
normal.explain: replica 是仿製複本，不是原件保證。

normal.desc: 【文法】The box had not been opened ___ it was put in the attic thirty years earlier.
options: A. by
B. since
C. during
D. while
normal.explain: since 接起始時間事件，配過去完成式表示至過去某時未開。

normal.desc: 【短文】A visitor calls a repaired bowl worthless because it is no longer perfect. Its owner says the repair records how the family continued using it. What gives the bowl value to the owner?
options: A. Its guaranteed selling price at a public auction.
B. Its similarity to a new bowl in a shop window.
C. Its connection with the family’s history of use.
D. Its ability to prove that no damage ever occurred.
normal.explain: 價值來自使用與修補的家庭歷史，不以無損或價格為依據。

normal.desc: 【語意】The object is older than the label suggests. What is being questioned?
options: A. The physical age of the printed label.
B. The position of the label beside the object.
C. The claim that the object has been repaired.
D. The age implied by the description.
normal.explain: label suggests 指標籤傳達物件年代，不是標籤紙本年齡。

normal.desc: 【短文】A diary describes a journey as uneventful. A later entry mentions missing a train and walking several miles. The owner laughs that she had forgotten to count that as an event. What is suggested?
options: A. The later entry proves the journey never occurred.
B. The owner thinks a missed train is a form of transport.
C. The diary’s first description understates what happened.
D. The journey took place on two separate continents.
normal.explain: uneventful 與實際插曲有幽默反差，不推測造假。

normal.desc: 【語用】It is not much to look at, but I would not part with it. What is the contrast?
options: A. Its high selling price versus the cost of repairing it.
B. Its impressive size versus the space available at home.
C. Its usefulness today versus the owner’s wish to replace it.
D. Its ordinary appearance versus its personal importance.
normal.explain: not much to look at 外表不起眼，not part with 不願割愛。

normal.desc: 【短文】A room is arranged to look as it did before its owner moved away. One modern lamp was added so visitors can see the letters. Which description is most precise?
options: A. The arrangement largely recreates an earlier setting with a practical addition.
B. The arrangement contains only objects that were present before the owner left.
C. The modern lamp proves that the letters were written after the owner moved.
D. The room has been redesigned without reference to its earlier appearance.
normal.explain: 承認整體重現及實用例外，不以單件現代物否定全部。

請唸出單字：仿照原物製作的複本
請唸出：已褪色而不易看清的題字
請唸出：鮮明清楚的回憶

normal.speak: the gift date may differ from the date of manufacture
normal.vocabId: R6:THE GIFT DATE MAY DIFFER FROM THE DATE OF MANUFACTURE

normal.desc: 請唸出：普通物件可以承載個人歷史
normal.ans: AN ORDINARY OBJECT CAN CARRY A PERSONAL HISTORY
normal.speak: an ordinary object can carry a personal history
normal.vocabId: R6:AN ORDINARY OBJECT CAN CARRY A PERSONAL HISTORY

normal.desc: 請拼出：刻寫或題寫在物上的文字（I 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：屋頂下方的閣樓空間（A 開頭，5 個字母）
請拼出：對過往事件的回想或記憶（R 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：D I S _ L A Y (供人觀看的展品安排)
填空題：D O _ A T _ O N (捐出的物品或金錢)
填空題：H E _ R _ O _ M (家族世代相傳的物品)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 照先前安排準時出現
B. 出乎意料地發生
C. 從藍色房間走出
D. 因天氣轉晴而延遲
normal.explain: out of the blue 指意外突然。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 向兩人同時要求幫忙
B. 把物品直接拿走兩件
C. 因驚訝而再看一眼
D. 把相同工作重做兩次
normal.explain: double take 是驚訝後再看以確認。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只看得見但聽不到
B. 靠近耳朵的傷口
C. 超出任何人視線之外
D. 在能聽見的距離內
normal.explain: earshot 指聲音可及的距離。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Is that your coat? It used to be, until my sister decided it suited her better.
options: A. 我與妹妹都確認外套不是我們任何人的。
B. 妹妹不喜歡這外套，所以一直由我穿。
C. 原本是我的，後來妹妹認為更適合她而拿去穿了。
D. 這件外套是妹妹買來後特地送給我的。
normal.explain: used to be 搭玩笑敘述暗示衣服被妹妹占用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I was about to knock when the door opened, so I never found out whether the bell worked.
options: A. 我按鈴後門才開，所以確定門鈴正常。
B. 我敲了很久沒人開，因此確定門鈴壞了。
C. 門一直開著，所以我進去修好門鈴。
D. 我正要敲門時門開了，所以沒弄清門鈴是否可用。
normal.explain: about to 尚未做，從未測試門鈴不能推它好壞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He said the walk was five minutes, but I suspect he meant five minutes for someone who knew where they were going.
options: A. 他說走五分鐘，我猜是對熟路的人而言。
B. 他明確表示我們必須在五分鐘內返回。
C. 說話者確認每個人都能五分鐘走完。
D. 說話者認為走錯路才會比較快抵達。
normal.explain: 質疑時間估計隱含熟路前提，不否定任何人五分鐘可達。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She offered me the last seat, though from the way she was holding her ankle I thought she needed it more.
options: A. 她因腳踝不舒服而要求我讓出最後座位。
B. 我確認她沒有任何不適，所以接受座位。
C. 她把座位留給另一人，沒有向我提議。
D. 她讓我最後座位，但看她扶腳踝，我覺得她更需要。
normal.explain: offer 與需求推測同時存在，不診斷傷勢。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I said it was a quiet village, not that nothing ever happened there. Those are not quite the same thing.
options: A. 我說村子安靜，不是從不發生事情，兩者不相同。
B. 我確認村子毫無事件，所以沒有故事可說。
C. 說話者撤回安靜的描述，改稱村子很吵。
D. 安靜在此被明確定義為沒有人居住。
normal.explain: quiet 不等於缺少任何事件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He looked relieved when I laughed, which made me wonder whether the remark had been intended as a joke at all.
options: A. 他顯得失望，因為說話者沒有理解那句笑話。
B. 我笑後他顯得鬆口氣，使我懷疑那句原本是否算玩笑。
C. 他先笑所以我才鬆口氣，確認雙方都只在開玩笑。
D. 說話者已證實那句話原本故意用來傷害人。
normal.explain: 反應引出對原意的疑問，非確定惡意。

normal.desc: 【文法】I recognised the woman ___ dog had followed us into the shop.
options: A. which
B. whose
C. who her
D. whom
normal.explain: whose dog 表那位女士的狗，為所有格關係詞。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to look quickly at something?
options: A. stumble
B. wander
C. glance
D. linger
normal.explain: glance 一瞥；linger 逗留、stumble 踉蹌、wander 閒逛。

normal.desc: 【空間】Mara stood beside the door while Ben waited on the opposite side of the room. Where was Ben in relation to Mara?
options: A. Immediately beside her at the door.
B. Outside the room behind the door.
C. Between her and the door she stood beside.
D. Across the room from her.
normal.explain: opposite side of room 指隔著房間對面，不是都在門邊。

normal.desc: 【順序】The light went out just as Nina reached for the handle. Which sequence is described?
options: A. The light failed long before Nina approached the door.
B. Nina waited until the light returned before moving.
C. The two events occurred at roughly the same time.
D. Nina had already opened the door before the light failed.
normal.explain: just as 表幾乎同時，未說已開門。

normal.desc: 【短文】Owen put the letter in his pocket, then searched the desk for it. His sister watched without speaking until he checked the pocket. What had he apparently forgotten?
options: A. Who had written the letter.
B. Why his sister had come into the room.
C. Which desk belonged to him.
D. Where he had just put the letter.
normal.explain: 行動先後顯示忘了自己放入口袋，未交代作者或來意。

normal.desc: 【文法】She spoke as though she ___ the place before, although she later admitted it was her first visit.
options: A. had visited
B. has visiting
C. will visit
D. was visit
normal.explain: 與實情不符的先前經驗用 as though + had visited。

normal.desc: 【短文】The shopkeeper wrapped the parcel twice. When asked why, he pointed at the rain. What is the likely purpose?
options: A. To make the parcel seem more expensive than it was.
B. To hide the fact that the parcel contained nothing.
C. To show that the shop had run out of bags.
D. To give the parcel extra protection during the journey.
normal.explain: 雨提供重包裝目的線索，其他動機未受支持。

normal.desc: 【短文】At dinner, Leo announced that he never misplaced anything. His mother slid his keys across the table without comment. What effect does her action have?
options: A. It quietly undercuts his claim.
B. It confirms that he has kept the keys with him.
C. It asks him to leave before dinner is finished.
D. It shows she wants to borrow his car.
normal.explain: 遞回他未留在身邊的鑰匙形成不必明說的反證。

normal.desc: 【語意】The narrator says, The village was smaller than I remembered, or perhaps I had finally grown. What is left open?
options: A. Whether growing older prevents people from recognising places.
B. Whether the difference lies in the place or the observer’s perspective.
C. Whether the narrator had ever visited the village before.
D. Whether the village has become too small for any residents.
normal.explain: or perhaps 提供視角成長的替代解釋，不否認記憶曾有地方。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：短暫看一眼的動作
請唸出單字：因不確定而短暫遲疑
請唸出：讓人不自在的停頓
請唸出：看來熟悉的人影
請唸出：她接受提議但未完全放下戒心
normal.ans: SHE ACCEPTED THE OFFER WITHOUT ENTIRELY RELAXING HER GUARD
normal.speak: she accepted the offer without entirely relaxing her guard
normal.vocabId: R6:SHE ACCEPTED THE OFFER WITHOUT ENTIRELY RELAXING HER GUARD

normal.desc: 請唸出：安靜地方仍可有多事的歷史
normal.ans: A QUIET PLACE CAN STILL HAVE AN EVENTFUL HISTORY
normal.speak: a quiet place can still have an eventful history
normal.vocabId: R6:A QUIET PLACE CAN STILL HAVE AN EVENTFUL HISTORY

normal.desc: 請拼出：因腳步不穩而踉蹌（S 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：在某處逗留而未立即離開（L 開頭，6 個字母）
請拼出：因不願意而有所猶豫的（R 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：D O O R _ T E P (房門外的階梯或門前位置)
填空題：S _ R _ P (用來攜帶固定物品的帶子)
填空題：F _ M _ _ E (笨拙地摸索或操作物品)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 位於右邊的所有物件
B. 採用最長的一條路線
C. 方向擺放正確
D. 剛好完成一整圈
normal.explain: right way round 指正確朝向，不等於右側。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 強迫物件立刻縮到最小
B. 忽略所有尺寸變動
C. 只准使用已經縮小的材料
D. 把縮小的可能性計入安排
normal.explain: allow for 是預留考量，shrinkage 收縮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 正式執行前的試做
B. 為比賽名次進行的衝刺
C. 已被判定失敗的唯一嘗試
D. 完成後才撰寫的檢討
normal.explain: trial run 測試流程，不必是跑步。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: This piece is a spare, so do not assume you have missed a step just because it is left over.
options: A. 剩下的零件已證明前面有一步做錯。
B. 這片必須最後裝上，否則不能算完成。
C. 備件用完後才可以開始正式步驟。
D. 這是備件，剩下不代表漏了步驟。
normal.explain: spare 備用，left over 非必然錯誤。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The picture shows the finished front; you will need to turn the card over to see where the ends are attached.
options: A. 圖示完成正面，要翻過卡片才看到尾端固定處。
B. 圖示背面，所以翻面才能看到完成正面。
C. 尾端只在卡片打開時才會顯示於正面。
D. 正反兩面在圖片中已同時完整展示。
normal.explain: front 與 turn over 指向背面隱藏的連接位置。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The measurement includes the border, which means the picture itself needs to be smaller than that.
options: A. 邊框有多寬都不會影響圖案可用空間。
B. 尺寸含邊框，所以圖案本身需更小。
C. 尺寸只量圖案，邊框需另外加上去。
D. 圖案本身應與含邊框總尺寸相等。
normal.explain: 總尺寸與內部可用尺寸不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is the distance between the holes that needs to match, not the distance from each hole to the outside edge.
options: A. 要相同的是孔與孔間距，不是每孔到外緣距離。
B. 要相同的是每孔到外緣距離，孔距無關。
C. 每個孔的直徑與孔距必須相同。
D. 說話者要求孔距與邊距兩種數值都相等。
normal.explain: 明確對比兩個測量位置。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The instructions give a minimum drying time, so reaching that time does not mean every piece will be ready under all conditions.
options: A. 說話者確認每件材料本來需要相同時間。
B. 說明給最低乾燥時間，到時不保證所有條件下每件都乾。
C. 到最低時間即保證任何環境每件都已乾。
D. 最低時間代表超過之後不能再等待。
normal.explain: minimum 是下限，不是各條件充分保證；非施工安全指南。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would keep the template until you have checked the first copy; otherwise you may reproduce the same small error several times.
options: A. 先做完所有複本，再看第一份是否有錯。
B. 說話者已確定第一份有錯，所以禁止繼續試做。
C. 先核對第一份再丟模板，否則可能複製同一小錯多次。
D. 模板只要保留，就不需要核對任何複本。
normal.explain: 保留模板便利核對修正，may 只是風險可能。

normal.desc: 【文法】Make sure the label ___ outwards before closing the box.
options: A. has facing
B. face it
C. faces
D. is face
normal.explain: the label 單數，指示子句用 faces，outwards 朝外。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective describes a mark that can be read clearly?
options: A. portable
B. flexible
C. reversible
D. legible
normal.explain: legible 指字跡可辨讀；其他為可攜、可彎、可逆。

normal.desc: 【尺寸】The card must be at least ten centimetres wide. Which width meets that requirement?
options: A. Ten centimetres.
B. Nine centimetres.
C. Eight and a half centimetres.
D. Any width below ten centimetres.
normal.explain: at least 包含等於下限，未說一定大於十。

normal.desc: 【順序】Fold the card before adding the ribbon. What should happen first?
options: A. The ribbon is added.
B. The ribbon is removed.
C. The folded card is discarded.
D. The card is folded.
normal.explain: before 明確指定折卡在加緞帶前。

normal.desc: 【短文】The kit contains enough paper for four cards. The instructions explain how to make one card. A learner concludes that the kit can produce only one. What has been confused?
options: A. The example’s scope with the quantity of supplied material.
B. The number of cards with the number of printed instructions.
C. The size of the paper with the length of the ribbon.
D. The cost of a kit with the price of a finished card.
normal.explain: 示範一張不等於材料只能做一張；題內明給四張。

normal.desc: 【文法】The design allows the cover ___ without removing the pages.
options: A. change itself
B. to be changed
C. being change
D. to changing
normal.explain: allow + 受詞 + to be changed，封面被換。

normal.desc: 【短文】A label says washable, while the note below asks users to remove the paper insert first. A person washes the item with the insert inside. What was missed?
options: A. The condition accompanying the washing instruction.
B. A requirement to replace the whole item after each use.
C. A warning that the item must never come into contact with water.
D. A promise that the paper insert would become stronger when wet.
normal.explain: 可洗標示附先取紙片條件，不能只讀主標籤。

normal.desc: 【語意】The pieces should fit snugly, without needing to be forced. Which description fits?
options: A. They are deliberately left loose enough to fall apart.
B. They sit closely together with little free movement.
C. They remain far apart so neither touches the other.
D. They can be joined only by applying substantial pressure.
normal.explain: snugly 緊密合適，後句排除強壓。

normal.desc: 【短文】The instructions say the two strips should be equal in length, not necessarily equal in width. A learner trims the widths to match. Which requirement has the learner added?
options: A. A rule that all dimensions must be measured in different units.
B. A requirement that the strips come from different sheets.
C. A second dimension that the instructions did not require to match.
D. A condition that the strips must have different lengths.
normal.explain: 長相等不強制寬相等，修寬增加未規定條件。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：供照樣複製或定位的樣板
請唸出單字：物件位置彼此對齊的狀態
請唸出：額外備用的組件
請唸出：能恢復原狀的第一步
請唸出：邊框包含在總尺寸內

normal.speak: the border is included in the total measurement
normal.vocabId: R6:THE BORDER IS INCLUDED IN THE TOTAL MEASUREMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：範例展示一種可能配色
normal.ans: THE EXAMPLE ILLUSTRATES ONE POSSIBLE COLOUR CHOICE
normal.speak: the example illustrates one possible colour choice
normal.vocabId: R6:THE EXAMPLE ILLUSTRATES ONE POSSIBLE COLOUR CHOICE

normal.desc: 請拼出：字跡清楚可辨讀的（L 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：物件外緣形成的輪廓（O 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：彼此成直角的（P 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：B O R _ E R (圍繞圖案或表面的邊框)
填空題：R I _ B _ N (用於裝飾繫結的緞帶)
填空題：D U _ L _ C _ T E (與原件相同的另一份複本)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 沿圓形路線走完一整圈
B. 建築最遠端的房間
C. 地圖任何邊角上的地方
D. 轉過附近街角的位置
normal.explain: around the corner 描述在附近拐角另一側，可引申即將到來。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 指定集合地點
B. 任何人可臨時自行選的地點
C. 仍在討論而完全未定的位置
D. 只供遺失物品存放的櫃台
normal.explain: designated 表已指定用途或角色。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只准單一職業使用的通道
B. 因原路受阻而改行的路線
C. 為娛樂而刻意安排的行程
D. 永遠最短且不會改變的捷徑
normal.explain: diversion 在交通語境指改道。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The desk is open until four, but the last collection is at half past three.
options: A. 櫃台開到四點，最後領取三點半。
B. 櫃台三點半關，但可以領取到四點。
C. 最後領取四點半，櫃台四點才開。
D. 四點前任何時候都已保證可領取。
normal.explain: 櫃台營業與服務截止不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You can enter through either gate, though only the west gate has somewhere to leave a bicycle.
options: A. 西門不能進人，僅供存放單車。
B. 兩道門都可進，只有西門有停單車處。
C. 只有西門可進，其餘門只准單車通過。
D. 兩門都有停單車處，只是西門較大。
normal.explain: either gate 准入，only west 限定停車設施。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The hall is directly above us, but the public stairs are at the far end of this corridor.
options: A. 公用樓梯正好在我們腳下的大廳內。
B. 大廳已不對外，所以樓梯也不能使用。
C. 大廳在正上方，但公用樓梯在走廊遠端。
D. 大廳就在走廊盡頭且與我們同層。
normal.explain: 垂直位置與實際到達路線不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The room numbers continue along the next corridor; they do not start again when you turn the corner.
options: A. 房號只用於目前走廊，轉角後全不適用。
B. 房號到下條走廊接續，不會轉角後重新起算。
C. 每轉一角房號都回到一號。
D. 下條走廊沒有房號，只有房間名稱。
normal.explain: continue rather than start again 表連續編號。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The nearest entrance on the map is not necessarily the quickest way in if you arrive when the main queue is longest.
options: A. 說話者確認所有入口必須排相同長度隊伍。
B. 只要主隊長，最近入口就會正式關閉。
C. 主隊最長時，地圖最近入口不一定最快。
D. 地圖最近入口無論排隊多久都一定最快。
normal.explain: 距離與等待時間共同影響總時間，不推關閉。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We moved the sign to where people actually make the choice, rather than where they first discover they have chosen wrongly.
options: A. 標示移到錯路盡頭，讓人先體驗再改道。
B. 人們已不需選路，所以標示全部撤下。
C. 說話者只比較標示字體，沒有改變位置。
D. 標示移到人們選路處，不是走錯後才發現之處。
normal.explain: 資訊要在決策點可見，而非事後補知。

normal.desc: 【文法】The entrance ___ you are looking for is on the other side of the building.
options: A. where
B. whose
C. what
D. that
normal.explain: looking for 的受詞是 entrance，用 that；where 不能直接作 for 受詞。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective means readily noticeable?
options: A. conspicuous
B. temporary
C. adjacent
D. optional
normal.explain: 此題 conspicuous 指顯眼；其他為暫時、相鄰、可選。

normal.desc: 【路線】The library is between the station and the park. Starting at the station, you reach the library before the park. What comes next along that route?
options: A. The library for a second time.
B. The park.
C. The station again.
D. A building behind the station.
normal.explain: 沿指定路線依序 station/library/park，圖內資訊已完整。

normal.desc: 【範圍】A sign says the upper floor is closed until noon. What does it establish?
options: A. Access is restricted for a stated period.
B. The whole building is closed for the day.
C. The upper floor will never reopen.
D. Every room downstairs is already occupied.
normal.explain: 告示只限制樓上至中午，不擴及全部建物。

normal.desc: 【短文】A sign says collections at the side counter and returns at the main counter. A visitor goes to the side counter to return a borrowed item. What has been confused?
options: A. A side entrance with a staff-only exit.
B. Two services assigned to different counters.
C. The opening time with the closing time.
D. A borrowed item with an item already purchased.
normal.explain: collections 領取、returns 歸還；兩窗口功能不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】The signs are being replaced so that visitors ___ find the entrance more easily.
options: A. are
B. have
C. can
D. had
normal.explain: so that 引目的，can + 原形 find。

normal.desc: 【短文】The booking page offers fifteen-minute arrival slots, but says visitors may stay for an hour after entering. A visitor thinks the visit lasts only fifteen minutes. What has been mistaken?
options: A. The closing hour for a fixed departure slot.
B. The arrival window for the permitted length of stay.
C. The admission price for the time of arrival.
D. The time spent inside for the waiting time outside.
normal.explain: 到場時段與可停留時間為兩種時間限制。

normal.desc: 【語用】It is only a short walk, provided you use the footbridge rather than follow the road all the way round. What qualifies the claim?
options: A. The footbridge is open only to staff.
B. The speaker guarantees the bridge is suitable for every visitor.
C. The route chosen affects the distance.
D. Every route has exactly the same length.
normal.explain: 短路程依賴行人橋路線，未保證普遍可及性。

normal.desc: 【短文】A centre advertises step-free access. Its notice explains that this entrance is at the back and closes earlier than the front one. What should a visitor check?
options: A. Whether the front entrance is closer to every possible starting point.
B. Whether closing the back entrance automatically closes the whole centre.
C. Whether step-free access guarantees that no visitor will need directions.
D. Whether the relevant entrance will be open at the planned arrival time.
normal.explain: 有免階梯入口仍需核對開放時間，不預測個人行動能力。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在觀眾看不見的幕後
B. 坐在最後一排看演出
C. 等所有場景結束之後
D. 將每幅布景反面展示
normal.explain: behind the scenes 指幕後工作或不公開的過程。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 偷偷複製節目所有台詞
B. 以精彩表現搶走全場注意
C. 未經允許把道具帶走
D. 在開演前取消整齣戲
normal.explain: steal the show 是成為最受矚目者的比喻。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 由觀眾自行決定何時開始
B. 完全沒有任何提示便任意行動
C. 在預定提示出現時準確行動
D. 在等候隊伍中依次排好
normal.explain: cue 是提示信號，on cue 應提示而準時。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The seats are numbered, but the rows are letters, so B twelve is in the second row.
options: A. 座位號碼只適用第一排，其餘可任意坐。
B. 座位用數字、排用字母，B十二在第二排。
C. B十二代表第十二排的第二個座位。
D. 排和座都用數字，B只是票種名稱。
normal.explain: 提供明確標記系統，不需外部座位慣例。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The microphone was working; the problem was that the music drowned out the first few words.
options: A. 最初幾個字太大聲，反而讓音樂聽不到。
B. 說話者確定台詞根本沒有被說出。
C. 麥克風有作用，問題是音樂蓋掉最初幾個字。
D. 麥克風壞了，所以音樂也完全沒有聲音。
normal.explain: 設備可運作仍有音量平衡問題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We need the pause to feel natural, not to last exactly the same number of seconds every night.
options: A. 停頓只要秒數一致，自然與否並不重要。
B. 說話者要求每晚完全刪除所有停頓。
C. 每晚秒數必須不同，才算符合唯一規則。
D. 停頓要自然，不是每晚固定同樣秒數。
normal.explain: 反對機械固定，不等於必須刻意每晚改秒數。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Do not rush the exit; the next entrance is timed from when the door actually closes.
options: A. 門必須一直開，否則沒人能再上場。
B. 退場越快，下一次入場就越一定正確。
C. 別急著退場，下次入場依門實際關上起算。
D. 下次入場按固定鐘點，與門何時關無關。
normal.explain: 計時起點是事件觸發，不是催退出時間。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I admired the acting more than I enjoyed the play, if that makes sense.
options: A. 我很喜歡戲本身，但認為演技無可取之處。
B. 我完全不懂表演，所以不願作任何評價。
C. 演技與戲本身在我看來得到相同程度肯定。
D. 我較欣賞演技，對戲本身享受較少。
normal.explain: 不同評價面向可不一致，more than 非全盤否定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The ending did not surprise me, but the way the actor reached it made it feel new.
options: A. 結局不意外，但演員演到結局的方式帶來新鮮感。
B. 結局被完全改寫，所以我無法認出原故事。
C. 演員只因忘詞而使結局看來不同。
D. 我認為熟悉的結局不可能帶來任何新感受。
normal.explain: 內容熟悉與詮釋新意可並存。

normal.desc: 【文法】The rehearsal will begin as soon as everyone ___ ready.
options: A. is
B. will being
C. are being
D. have been
normal.explain: everyone 單數；未來時間子句用現在式 is ready。

normal.desc: 【字彙】An understudy is a performer who ___.
options: A. has bought a cheaper ticket for the last row
B. learns a role in order to replace another performer if needed
C. watches a performance from below the stage
D. writes every word spoken by the leading actor
normal.explain: understudy 是準備必要時代演的人，不是看台下方的人。

normal.desc: 【語意】The show is sold out, but returned tickets may become available. What is possible?
options: A. The performance has been cancelled and refunded.
B. New seats will certainly be added to the hall.
C. A cancelled booking might release a ticket.
D. Everyone who waits is guaranteed a ticket.
normal.explain: sold out 不排除後續退票，may 不保證。

normal.desc: 【順序】The lights dimmed before the music started, while the curtain remained closed. What had happened when the music began?
options: A. The lights had returned to full brightness.
B. The lights had already become less bright.
C. The curtain had already been raised.
D. The audience had already left the room.
normal.explain: before 指先變暗；curtain remained closed 排除升幕。

normal.desc: 【短文】The ticket includes admission to the performance but not the optional talk afterwards. A visitor assumes the talk is part of the ticket because it is on the same evening. What should be checked?
options: A. Whether the performance and talk use the same language.
B. Which speaker has bought a ticket for the performance.
C. Which activities the stated admission covers.
D. Whether the evening contains enough hours for both events.
normal.explain: 同晚不等於同票涵蓋，題幹已限不含talk。

normal.desc: 【文法】I wish the audience ___ their phones on silent before the show began.
options: A. have putting
B. will put
C. would put yesterday
D. had put
normal.explain: 對過去未做的事遺憾，用 wish + 過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【短文】During a rehearsal, an actor skips a speech so the team can practise the scene change. A visitor thinks the speech has been removed from the final show. What has been overlooked?
options: A. The visitor has already been given the final revised script.
B. The speech can be performed only after the audience has left.
C. The immediate purpose of this rehearsal may differ from a full performance.
D. Every rehearsal must include every word in its final order.
normal.explain: 練轉場可暫略台詞，不能直接推永久刪除。

normal.desc: 【語用】The play was shorter than I expected, though I would not have wanted it any longer. What is the evaluation?
options: A. It was too brief to include the ending.
B. The speaker wanted a longer version of the same performance.
C. The speaker had expected no performance at all.
D. Its length was surprising but suited the experience.
normal.explain: 較預期短但不想加長，非必嫌短。

normal.desc: 【短文】The audience laughs before a character finishes a sentence. The actor waits, then delivers the last few words when the room is quiet. What is the likely reason?
options: A. To allow the remaining words to be heard.
B. To signal that the forgotten ending has been replaced.
C. To ask the audience to leave before the next scene.
D. To show that the character has stopped speaking permanently.
normal.explain: 等笑聲退以免蓋台詞，未給忘詞證據。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 替我把所有文件逐行抄好
B. 有空傳個短訊息給我
C. 把電線從樓上放下來
D. 在名單上把我的姓名刪除
normal.explain: drop a line 指簡短聯繫。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只准用鉛筆寫任何信件
B. 把該事項永久劃掉不再討論
C. 先暫定排進行程
D. 把安排確認為永不可改
normal.explain: pencil in 表暫定，常仍可調整。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把物品留著不要讓我碰
B. 等我回來前不准任何人決定
C. 正式宣布事情已處理完畢
D. 把這事交給我處理
normal.explain: 常用於承接調查或處理，未保證已完成。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Did you send the attachment? I thought I had, but I have just noticed it is still in my drafts.
options: A. 說話者從未想寄附件，只準備空白信。
B. 草稿已收回，附件則由別人轉寄。
C. 以為已寄附件，但剛發現還在草稿。
D. 附件已寄，剛發現收件者刪掉了。
normal.explain: thought vs just noticed 修正先前以為已完成的狀態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would rather hear that the date does not work than have you agree and struggle to make it.
options: A. 我希望你先答應，之後再處理無法出席的問題。
B. 只要你無法出席，就不必告訴我任何原因或日期。
C. 說話者認為所有人都應取消其他安排來配合。
D. 我寧願知道日期不合，也不想你答應後勉強趕來。
normal.explain: 鼓勵誠實回應而非勉強承諾，非禁止出席。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The message sounded urgent, although the deadline at the bottom is not until next month.
options: A. 訊息聽來急，但文末截止其實到下月。
B. 截止已過一個月，所以語氣不急也需立即處理。
C. 訊息已明說月底之前任何時間都不接受回覆。
D. 語氣與日期完全一致，沒有需要注意的落差。
normal.explain: 語氣急迫與實際時間資訊有反差，不判是否真緊急。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I did not mean to leave you out; I assumed the invitation had already reached you through Sam.
options: A. 我故意只邀山姆，並要求他不准告訴你。
B. 我確認你收到了，所以現在撤回邀請。
C. 山姆已承認拒絕轉交，說話者也同意。
D. 不是有意漏你，我以為山姆已把邀請給你。
normal.explain: 說明自身假設與意圖，未證明Sam實際做了什麼。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I appreciate the reminder, though I would have preferred it before I had made the arrangements rather than afterwards.
options: A. 謝謝提醒，但希望在我安排前而非之後告知。
B. 提醒來得太早，所以我還無法開始安排。
C. 我已因這次提醒取消所有安排，也不感謝對方。
D. 說話者認為提醒只在事情全部結束後才有用。
normal.explain: 肯定提醒功能但批評時機已晚。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation is open-ended about when I visit, not about how long I stay once I arrive.
options: A. 說話者認為不能決定日期就等於沒有邀請。
B. 邀請對何時來沒限定，不代表停留多久也無限。
C. 何時來固定，來後停留則完全不受限制。
D. 邀請已保證可永久住下，不需再確認。
normal.explain: when versus how long，開放範圍不能外推。

normal.desc: 【文法】Would you mind ___ me know if the date changes?
options: A. having let to
B. letting
C. to let
D. let
normal.explain: mind 後用動名詞 letting，let me know 為告知。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to accept that a message has been received?
options: A. enclose
B. redirect
C. acknowledge
D. postpone
normal.explain: acknowledge 在訊息語境可指確認收到，非一定贊同內容。

normal.desc: 【語意】The letter says, Please reply by Monday, even if your answer is no. What is requested?
options: A. A response only from people who accept the invitation.
B. An explanation of why Monday is an unsuitable date.
C. A decision to accept unless a reply arrives on Monday.
D. A response regardless of whether the invitation is accepted.
normal.explain: even if no 明示婉拒也需回覆。

normal.desc: 【指涉】I can lend you the blue folder, but I need the red one back tonight. What does one refer to?
options: A. A colour sample.
B. A loan application.
C. A folder.
D. A night.
normal.explain: one 代替前面的 folder，red one 為紅文件夾。

normal.desc: 【短文】A message reads, I am free on Tuesday after three, or on Thursday before noon. Which proposed meeting fits?
options: A. Tuesday at two in the afternoon.
B. Thursday at one in the afternoon.
C. Thursday at twelve thirty.
D. Tuesday at four in the afternoon.
normal.explain: after three / before noon 分別限定不同日，不能跨用時段。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would have replied sooner if your message ___ in the wrong folder.
options: A. had not ended up
B. has not ending
C. would not end
D. was not end
normal.explain: 過去未回覆的反事實條件，用 had not ended up。

normal.desc: 【短文】A friend writes, Bring anyone you like, but let me know how many are coming before I order food. What remains necessary?
options: A. Having every guest order food separately.
B. Asking permission for each guest’s individual identity.
C. Waiting until the food arrives to choose guests.
D. Providing the number of guests in advance.
normal.explain: 人選自由仍有先報人數條件。

normal.desc: 【語用】Thanks for checking rather than just assuming, a writer replies after being asked whether an old plan still applies. What is appreciated?
options: A. The decision to confirm a potentially outdated arrangement.
B. The other person’s promise never to change the old plan.
C. The absence of any need to discuss future arrangements.
D. The assumption that silence always means the plan is unchanged.
normal.explain: 肯定查證，不保證原安排確實未變。

normal.desc: 【短文】A message says, I can collect the parcel if it is still there at six. A recipient replies, Great, I will tell them you are definitely coming. What changed?
options: A. The recipient has withdrawn permission to collect the parcel.
B. A conditional offer has been reported as a firm commitment.
C. A promise to deliver a parcel has become a promise to collect one.
D. The collection time has moved from six to an earlier hour.
normal.explain: if still there 的條件被刪去，確定度擴大。

options: A. 專為休息而設的山頂房間
B. 因看不到雲而取消行程
C. 雲層暫時出現空隙
D. 雲層變得完全不能分開
normal.explain: break 指中斷或開口，這裡為雲隙。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必定沒有任何人的荒地
B. 只在地圖上標示的污點
C. 完全無遮蔽物的高地
D. 較不受風雨直接影響的地方
normal.explain: sheltered 有遮護，不等於保證任何天氣都安全。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 位於視野遠方的地平線上
B. 緊貼在觀察者腳邊
C. 藏在不透光物件內部
D. 正位於頭頂且無法看見
normal.explain: on horizon 此處空間義，也可比喻將發生。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We could hear the river long before we could see it through the trees.
options: A. 先看見河很久後，才開始聽到聲音。
B. 河被樹遮住，因此完全無法發出聲音。
C. 說話者一直沒聽見也沒看見河。
D. 穿過樹間看見河之前很久，就聽到河聲。
normal.explain: 聲音先於視覺線索。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The light kept changing, so the same patch of hillside looked different every time I glanced back.
options: A. 光一直變，每次回看同片山坡都不同。
B. 山坡每次回看都已移到另一個位置。
C. 光線從未改變，只有山坡顏色真的變了。
D. 說話者只看山坡一次，所以無法比較。
normal.explain: 光照改變表觀，不是地理位置移動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It was not raining under the trees, exactly; the rain had stopped, but the branches were still letting it go.
options: A. 樹下完全沒水，所以不需區分來源。
B. 樹下不算正在下雨，是雨停後枝條仍落水。
C. 雨還持續，但樹枝已完全乾燥。
D. 說話者確認所有水都是河流濺上去的。
normal.explain: 修正下雨表象，擬人lettinggo指餘水滴落。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The view opens up after the bend; from here the wall hides most of it.
options: A. 彎後視野才開闊，此處牆擋了大部分。
B. 此處已看見全部，彎後反而完全被牆擋。
C. 彎後沒有路，所以視野與路線無關。
D. 牆剛被拆掉，從這裡現在能看見全部。
normal.explain: 現在/後續位置對比，opensup指視野展開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The place was peaceful without feeling abandoned; someone had swept the step and left a mug beside the door.
options: A. 說話者認為寧靜必定表示從未有人居住。
B. 地方寧靜卻不像廢棄，掃過階梯和門邊杯子有生活痕跡。
C. 地方完全廢棄，因門邊杯子證明多年沒有人。
D. 階梯與杯子已被確認只是遊客中心的佈景。
normal.explain: 微小照料痕跡建立有人氣的平和印象。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I remember the smell of wet stone more clearly than the view we had walked all that way to see.
options: A. 說話者完全沒看到景，因而不可能記住任何畫面。
B. 氣味較清楚已證明整段行程沒有視覺經驗。
C. 我對濕石氣味的記憶，比走那麼遠要看的景更清楚。
D. 走那麼遠是為聞石頭，風景本來不是目的。
normal.explain: 實際記憶焦點與原定觀景目的不同，非否定看過。

normal.desc: 【文法】By the time we reached the ridge, the sun ___ behind the clouds.
options: A. will disappear
B. was disappear
C. had disappeared
D. has disappearing
normal.explain: 過去抵達前已不見，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb describes small drops of light rain falling?
options: A. glitter
B. ripple
C. rustle
D. drizzle
normal.explain: drizzle 下毛毛雨；其餘為閃爍、泛漣漪、沙沙作響。

normal.desc: 【空間】The path ran along the river, with the hill to our left and the water to our right. What was immediately to the walkers’ right?
options: A. The river.
B. The top of the hill.
C. The opposite side of the hill.
D. The path behind them.
normal.explain: water 與river同指，明示位於右側。

normal.desc: 【順序】The rain stopped before dawn, but the leaves were still dripping when the first light appeared. What persisted after the rain?
options: A. Heavy rain beginning before sunrise.
B. Complete darkness after daylight arrived.
C. Dry leaves blowing across the road.
D. Water falling from wet leaves.
normal.explain: 雨停後葉上餘水仍滴落，與雨繼續不同。

normal.desc: 【短文】The guide called the lake calm. A child pointed to small waves near the shore. The guide explained that calm did not mean perfectly still. What is distinguished?
options: A. A general condition from the complete absence of movement.
B. The lake’s depth from the height of the surrounding hills.
C. A child’s view from a photograph taken below the water.
D. The shore’s location from the direction of the path.
normal.explain: 相對平靜仍可有小波，不必絕對靜止。

normal.desc: 【文法】The further we walked from the road, ___ we heard.
options: A. so few traffic
B. the less traffic
C. less than traffic
D. the least of traffic
normal.explain: the further ..., the less ...；traffic 不可數。

normal.desc: 【短文】A cottage looked deserted from the path. As the travellers approached, smoke rose from its chimney and a dog barked inside. What happens to the first impression?
options: A. New details suggest that the cottage may be occupied.
B. The new details prove nobody has entered for years.
C. The travellers discover that they were looking at a photograph.
D. The chimney smoke shows that the path has changed direction.
normal.explain: 初看空無人後有生活線索，may避免確證誰在家。

normal.desc: 【氣氛】The road was familiar, but in the fading light every turning seemed to hesitate before revealing itself. What effect does the description create?
options: A. Every turning is clearly marked by newly installed signs.
B. A known place feels uncertain as visibility decreases.
C. The road is described as physically changing its route.
D. The narrator has forgotten that the walk took place in daylight.
normal.explain: 路口擬人化，暗光讓熟悉路也顯猶疑。

normal.desc: 【短文】We reached the viewpoint expecting a grand sunset. A cloud covered the sun, but its edge briefly shone like a silver thread. Why might the narrator mention the edge?
options: A. The narrator has abandoned visual description for a map.
B. The travellers can now see every place they visited earlier.
C. A small unexpected detail replaces the anticipated spectacle.
D. The edge proves that the sun has stopped setting.
normal.explain: 宏大期待被微小亮邊取代，關注轉移而非完全無景。

請唸出：光線變化使同片山坡看來不同

normal.speak: the changing light made the same hillside look different

normal.ans: THE SOUND REACHED US BEFORE THE RIVER CAME INTO SIGHT
normal.speak: the sound reached us before the river came into sight
normal.vocabId: R6:THE SOUND REACHED US BEFORE THE RIVER CAME INTO SIGHT

normal.desc: 請拼出：因潮濕等而閃出柔亮光澤（G 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：天空與地面或海面看似相接的遠線（H 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：發出細碎沙沙聲（R 開頭，6 個字母）
填空題：R I _ G E (山脈或山丘頂部狹長的高線)
填空題：R I _ P _ E (水面細小的波紋)

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在同一家店內繞行但不比較
B. 不經考慮就立即購買
C. 把商店搬到另一個地區
D. 比較不同賣家的選擇與價格
normal.explain: shop around 是購前比較，非必真的繞圈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 目前沒有可供應的庫存
B. 永遠不會再生產的每件商品
C. 已購但尚未開箱的物品
D. 仍只在櫥窗裡展示而不標價
normal.explain: out of stock只說當下無庫存，不保證永停產。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 製作時增加的裝飾布條
B. 正常使用逐漸造成的磨損
C. 由一次蓄意破壞造成的所有損害
D. 商品標示的穿衣尺寸
normal.explain: wear and tear常指日常使用消耗痕跡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The price is for the pair, not for each one, though the stand is sold separately.
options: A. 價格是一對，底座另售。
B. 每件都此價，底座已包含在內。
C. 一對只含其中一件，另一件必須借用。
D. 價格只給底座，成對物件完全不出售。
normal.explain: pair/eacheone/stand三個範圍需分清。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would keep the receipt even if you are sure about the colour; it also records which version you bought.
options: A. 說話者確認留下收據即保證可依任何制度退貨。
B. 即使確定喜歡顏色也留收據，因它記載購買版本。
C. 收據只記顏色，並不包含任何版本資訊。
D. 顏色確定後，版本就不可能再成為問題。
normal.explain: 保留資訊用途，不推真實消費法規。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The replacement looks the same, but the handle is on the opposite side, which matters for how I use it.
options: A. 把手不同側已證明每位使用者都無法使用。
B. 說話者只比較照片大小，而未談實際用法。
C. 替代品外觀相似，但把手在反側，影響我的用法。
D. 替代品把手同側，所以使用差異只在顏色。
normal.explain: 外觀近似與功能適配可不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I borrowed it to see whether it would fit, not because I had already decided to keep it.
options: A. 說話者承認自己從未得到借用許可。
B. 我借來試是否合適，不是已決定留下。
C. 我已決定留下，所以不會再測是否合適。
D. 借用已被雙方明訂為完成購買。
normal.explain: 試用/檢查與確定持有不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The cheaper one would save space on the shelf, but it would not hold everything we need it to hold.
options: A. 容量足夠，但架子已被確認無法承重。
B. 說話者認為價格低就不可能有任何優點。
C. 較便宜那個省架上空間，卻裝不下所需物件。
D. 較便宜那個較大，所以一定更能滿足需求。
normal.explain: 優點省空間、限制容量並存，非承重事實。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not suggesting we replace something that works; I am asking whether it still works for the purpose we now have.
options: A. 我確認物件完全壞了，所以任何用途都不能再用。
B. 如今用途已明示未變，換新只為追求流行。
C. 說話者認為只要能開動就滿足任何目的。
D. 我不是說換掉能用的，而是問是否仍合如今用途。
normal.explain: 運作正常與當前用途適合不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】The size I need ___ currently out of stock.
options: A. are
B. have
C. being
D. is
normal.explain: 主詞 the size 單數，I need 是修飾子句。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which noun means an extra supply kept available for later use?
options: A. reserve
B. sample
C. receipt
D. display
normal.explain: reserve 是儲備；其他為樣品、收據、展示。

normal.desc: 【數量】A box contains six cups. A customer needs eight cups and may buy individual cups as well as boxes. Which purchase supplies exactly eight?
options: A. Three boxes without any individual cups.
B. One box and two individual cups.
C. Two boxes and two individual cups.
D. One box and one individual cup.
normal.explain: 六加二等八；題內提供單購選項。

normal.desc: 【範圍】A sign says the offer applies to marked items only. Which condition matters?
options: A. The item must carry the relevant mark.
B. The customer must buy every item on the shelf.
C. The shop must close before the purchase is made.
D. The item must have the highest price in its category.
normal.explain: only限markeditems，題內未設價格高低門檻。

normal.desc: 【短文】A stall lends tools for a day and asks borrowers to return them before closing. A visitor assumes a day means the following morning. What should govern the return?
options: A. A general assumption that all stalls share the same policy.
B. The explicit closing-time condition.
C. The visitor’s usual waking time.
D. The time the tool was originally manufactured.
normal.explain: 題內明訂截止，不以抽象一天代替。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would rather ___ the one I already have than buy another.
options: A. to repair
B. repaired
C. repair
D. repairing
normal.explain: would rather 後原形repair，than buy平行。

normal.desc: 【短文】A customer borrows a display sample to check its colour at home. The assistant says the boxed item may have a different surface finish. What still needs checking?
options: A. Whether the customer has visited every shop selling similar items.
B. Whether the final item matches the desired finish as well as the colour.
C. Whether the sample can be counted as an additional boxed purchase.
D. Whether the shop’s walls are painted in the customer’s chosen colour.
normal.explain: 樣品能查色但未保證表面處理同款，須核第二面向。

normal.desc: 【語用】It is a bargain only if you were going to use it, says a friend about an unwanted discounted item. What is the point?
options: A. The friend has promised to buy the item instead.
B. An item is useful only when sold at its original price.
C. A low price alone does not establish value for this buyer.
D. Every discounted item must be defective.
normal.explain: 便宜與對個人有價值不同，不推瑕疵或原價必需。

normal.desc: 【短文】An exchange table lets visitors take one item for each item they leave. Jo leaves three objects, takes two, and asks whether she has used the whole allowance. What follows from the rule?
options: A. She must take three more items.
B. She has already exceeded the allowance.
C. She must retrieve one of her original objects.
D. She may take one more item.
normal.explain: 三換三上限，已取二還可一，未說必須取滿。

請唸出單字：用來替代另一物的替代品
請唸出：只涉及外觀的差異
請唸出：能配合原系統使用的替換品
請唸出：低價不證成對個人有用

normal.speak: a low price does not establish personal usefulness
normal.vocabId: R6:A LOW PRICE DOES NOT ESTABLISH PERSONAL USEFULNESS

normal.desc: 請唸出：把手位置對預定用途重要
normal.ans: THE HANDLE POSITION MATTERS FOR THE INTENDED USE
normal.speak: the handle position matters for the intended use
normal.vocabId: R6:THE HANDLE POSITION MATTERS FOR THE INTENDED USE

normal.desc: 請拼出：超過所需的剩餘量（S 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：把耗去的存量補足（R 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：能與另一物共同適用而不衝突的（C 開頭，10 個字母）
